AI.motivation: 深度神经网络的内部计算是黑盒的，现有可解释性方法（如探针、神经元分析、自然语言描述）要么难以形式化验证，要么缺乏足够的细粒度。论文旨在寻找一种既人类可读又可形式化验证、且能直接替换神经组件的"中间语言"——即可执行代码，从而实现对Transformer注意力头的因果级机制解释，并迈向模型行为的符号化透明性。
AI.method: 方法分四步：(1) 在大量训练样本上提取目标模型各注意力头的注意力矩阵；(2) 将这些矩阵的统计摘要（约2.5%最大权重）组织成约4000 token的结构化提示词，喂给一个合成智能体（Claude Sonnet 4），生成候选Python函数（可用NumPy、spaCy、NLTK）；(3) 用Jensen-Shannon散度（JSD）对候选程序打分，选出最优者并基于"最佳/最差样本"反馈进行一轮迭代精炼；(4) 在验证集上用交并比（IoU）作为最终排序指标选出最佳代理程序π*。最终库包含约1664个程序，总合成成本约150美元。评估包含两阶段：相关性评估（IoU对齐）和因果评估（替换注意力头后测量困惑度与下游QA基准性能）。
AI.result: 在四个模型上，最佳程序平均IoU随模型规模提升：GPT-2约69%，TinyLlama-1.1B约74%，Llama-3B约79%，部分头接近99%；BERT-base因双向注意力最难符号化。按IoU贪心替换注意力头：替换25%头部仅带来平均16%的困惑度上升，且对HellaSwag、PIQA、SciQ、ARC-Easy、SocialIQA、COPA等下游QA任务性能影响有限；替换30–40%的头仍不显著降低任务表现。IoU与替换后困惑度上升之间Spearman相关性>0.9，表明IoU可作为因果保真度的可靠代理指标。早层头部多为"首token/位置锚定"类，中后层出现更多句法/话语功能程序。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明：在现代自回归Transformer中，相当比例的注意力头行为可以被简洁的Python程序以高IoU近似，且这些程序可以因果性地直接插入模型前向传播而几乎不损害性能，为LLM机制的符号化可解释性提供了一个可扩展的、端到端的流水线。该工作将LM引导的程序合成确立为机制可解释性的一个可行范式，向"完整符号化表征"的目标迈出了具体一步。

title: UBP2: Uncertainty-Balanced Preference Planning for Efficient Preference-based Reinforcement Learning
summary: Preference-based RL provides an approach to learning reward models from pairwise comparisons of behaviors, bypassing the need for explicit reward design. However, existing methods typically rely on passive data collection and suffer from poor sample efficiency, especially during the early stages of learning. We introduce a model-based approach that actively directs exploration by jointly reasoning over uncertainties in the reward, dynamics, and value functions. Our method, Uncertainty-Balanced Preference Planning (UBP2), uses ensembles of reward, dynamics, and value function models to evaluate candidate trajectories according to a unified score that combines expected reward, terminal value, and epistemic uncertainty. Planning under this objective yields an explicit tradeoff between exploitation and information acquisition without requiring ad hoc exploration heuristics. Under standard regularity assumptions, we establish sublinear regret guarantees for both finite-horizon and infinite-horizon settings. Empirically, experiments on the Meta-World benchmark show UBP2 achieves substantially higher sample efficiency than model-free preference-based methods and non-optimistic model-based baselines.

AI.tldr: UBP2（Uncertainty-Balanced Preference Planning）是一种基于模型的偏好强化学习方法，通过集成奖励、动力学和价值函数模型，同时利用三者的不确定性来主动引导探索，在偏好反馈预算有限的情况下实现高效样本学习。
AI.motivation: 传统的偏好强化学习（PbRL）方法通常依赖被动数据收集，样本效率低，尤其在学习早期阶段表现不佳。现有方法要么是无模型的被动探索，要么只利用单一不确定性来源，无法在探索与利用之间实现显式平衡。此外，现有基于偏好的RL方法尚未充分利用基于模型的规划优势来主动收集信息丰富的轨迹。
AI.method: UBP2采用基于TD-MPC2的模型预测控制（MPC）框架，集成了奖励、动力学和价值函数的集成模型。规划目标将期望累积奖励、终端价值与三者认知不确定性（epistemic uncertainty）显式结合，其中奖励不确定性通过Jensen-Rényi散度（JRD）度量，动力学和价值不确定性通过集成分歧度量。不确定性权重λ_r、λ_d、λ_q通过自动调优机制在线学习。此外，UBP2提出了一种乐观偏好标签查询策略，基于预测偏好似然和奖励不确定性在全球范围内选择最有信息量的轨迹段对。偏好预算耗尽后，切换到学习到的策略执行。
AI.result: 在标准规律性假设下，UBP2在有限和无限时间范围内都建立了关于交互轮次的次线性遗憾界，该遗憾界依赖于动力学和奖励核的最大信息增益。在Meta-World基准测试的10个操作任务上的实验表明，UBP2在9个任务上比无模型偏好方法（RUNE、MRN）和非乐观的基于模型的基线（MBP）实现了更高的样本效率，平均IQM成功率达到76.1%，优于所有基线方法。消融实验证实了奖励、动力学和价值不确定性组件以及乐观偏好选择的贡献。规划视野和反馈预算的敏感性分析也验证了该方法的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: UBP2通过在单一规划目标中统一结合奖励、动力学和价值函数的认知不确定性，实现了偏好强化学习中探索与利用的显式权衡。该方法无需临时探索启发式，在样本效率方面显著优于现有方法，并具有理论遗憾保证。这项工作为高效偏好强化学习提供了一个有原则的框架，将不确定性引导的规划与偏好学习紧密结合。

title: Mixed-Precision Communication-Avoiding SGD for Generalized Linear Models on GPUs
summary: Distributed stochastic gradient descent (SGD) is limited by communication rather than computation, since each iteration requires an AllReduce across processes. Communication-avoiding SGD (CA-SGD) amortizes communication over $s$ iterations by replacing $s$ consecutive AllReduces with a single AllReduce of an $sb\times sb$ Gram matrix, trading more computation and bandwidth for fewer synchronization points. Modern GPUs with matrix hardware and reduced-precision formats offset this by accelerating the Gram GEMM and shrinking BF16 traffic. We study mixed-precision CA-SGD for generalized linear models on NVIDIA GPUs. Our finite-precision analysis decomposes the local rounding error of one CA-SGD outer iteration into nine independent precision choices, depending on the hardware only through its low-precision unit roundoffs, so the resulting recipes transfer in principle across GPU generations. The recipe stores the input matrix and margin vector in low precision, computes the Gram matrix from low-precision inputs with high-precision accumulation, communicates it in high precision, and performs the inner recurrence and weight updates in high precision. On NERSC Perlmutter A100 GPUs, mixed-precision CA-SGD matches FP32 SGD loss within $0.5\%$ on logistic, linear, and Poisson problems and reaches $5.1$--$6.8\times$ speedup over FP32 SGD on epsilon, SUSY, HIGGS, synth, and Poisson-synth. Our software is available at this https URL

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对GPU上广义线性模型的混合精度通信避免随机梯度下降（CA-SGD）方法。通过将外层迭代中的局部舍入误差分解为九个独立精度选择，给出了A100 GPU上的具体BF16精度配方（Recipe C），在保持FP32 SGD精度（损失差距<0.5%）的同时实现5.1-6.8倍的加速。
AI.motivation: 分布式SGD受通信延迟而非计算限制，传统mini-batch SGD每次迭代都需要AllReduce同步。在GPU上虽然可以通过BF16等低精度格式减少通信量，但统一的低精度无法满足所有操作的舍入误差敏感度需求。因此需要为不同操作（9种不同类型的核）独立选择精度，并通过严格的有限精度分析指导选择。
AI.method: 1. 将一次CA-SGD外层迭代分解为9个独立精度槽位（u_A, u_G, u_r, u_c, u_σ, u_g, u_AR,r, u_AR,G, u_x）；2. 基于Higham因子和IEEE-754舍入模型，推导出局部前向误差的加性分解（定理5.7），包含9个主导项，每项对应一个精度选择；3. 由扰动SGD收敛性定理（定理5.9）将局部误差提升为有界区域内的收敛邻域保证；4. 基于误差系数直接推导出Recipe C（A100 BF16混合精度配方），Gram GEMM使用BF16输入/FP32累加，内层修正和权重更新保留FP32；5. 在NERSC Perlmutter A100上使用CUDA Graph、cuBLAS、NCCL实现并验证。
AI.result: 在logistic、linear和Poisson回归问题上，Recipe C在最终损失上与FP32 SGD基线差距<0.5%。在epsilon、SUSY、HIGGS、synth和Poisson-synth数据集上，(b,s)=(8,64)时实现5.2-6.2倍加速（理论覆盖范围），在synth上(b,s)=(1,256)时达16.57倍加速。Gram GEMM在s=128时达到BF16张量核峰值92%（285.9 TFLOP/s）。256个GPU弱扩展效率0.741（FP32为0.668）。Recipe D（Gram AllReduce也用BF16）可达6.8倍加速但超出理论保证范围。
AI.conclusion: 混合精度CA-SGD需要联合设计s步重构和精度分配。九槽位误差分析理论性地证明了Recipe C作为默认选择的合理性，并为Lipschitz残差GLM族提供了有界区域内的收敛邻域保证。结果表明：在保持FP32 SGD精度的前提下，BF16混合精度配方在A100 GPU上可获得显著加速，验证了通信避免算法与混合精度硬件加速器协同设计的有效性。

title: Flexible Distributed Particle Filtering for the Internet of Things via Aggregate Computing
summary: State estimation from uncertain, distributed observations is central in many cyber-physical applications. While Distributed Particle Filtering (DPF) algorithms address nonlinear and non-Gaussian estimations in distributed settings, most solutions remain tied to specific architectures and communication assumptions, limiting adaptability in open, heterogeneous deployments-most notably, the Internet of Things (IoT). In this paper, we propose a field-based formulation of Distributed Particle Filtering grounded in Aggregate Computing (AC). By expressing estimation and information dissemination as computational fields, our approach decouples the core filtering logic from coordination and data-flow strategies. This enables systematic customisation of key design dimensions, including fusion-center placement and resilience, aggregated measurement functions, as well as the type and scope of information propagation. Through a set of in-silico experiments, we show how diverse DPF configurations can be derived within a unified framework, highlighting trade-offs among accuracy, communication cost, and robustness. Overall, the proposed approach positions AC as an effective abstraction layer for engineering adaptable DPF solutions in open IoT environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于聚合计算(Aggregate Computing, AC)的分布式粒子滤波(DPF)场式(field-based)形式化方法，将状态估计和信息传播建模为计算场，实现滤波逻辑与协调机制的解耦，从而在统一的编程模型中灵活定制融合中心、聚合测量函数和信息传播范围等关键设计维度。
AI.motivation: 现有的分布式粒子滤波(DPF)方法虽然能够应对非线性和非高斯估计问题，但大多与特定的网络架构和通信假设紧密耦合，难以适应开放的、异构的物联网(IoT)部署环境。当传感器、拓扑或可靠性发生变化时，往往需要对算法进行重大修改而非简单重配置，限制了DPF在IoT场景中的适用性。
AI.method: 该方法将AC作为抽象层，利用场演算(FC)的核心思想——计算场(computational fields)——来建模DPF。具体地：(1)将融合中心角色建模为通过自稳定领导选举动态分配的运行时角色，而非静态指定；(2)通过聚合算子将邻居传感器的原始局部测量组合为聚合测量函数(通过似然乘积实现)，用于粒子加权；(3)支持基于局部可观测性条件的空间自适应计算(如分布式分支)和基于自组织协调区域(SCR)的分区估计；(4)使用Kotlin的Collektive框架实现，并在Alchemist仿真器中进行验证。实验场景为25个传感器部署在二维网格上的目标跟踪，目标按非线性轨迹运动(γ(t) = (vt, (vt + 5sin(0.3vt))/2))。
AI.result: 通过两组仿真实验验证：(1)邻居级聚合测量函数实验表明，随着邻居数量从0增加到7，估计精度和稳定性显著提升，RMSE随时间降低，单邻居即可带来明显改善；(2)基于领导选举的融合中心实验表明，当领导节点在时间步1500失效后，系统能够自动选举新领导，经短暂瞬态后恢复跟踪功能，证明了方法的自愈能力和鲁棒性。结果表明，基于场的形式化方法能够在保持去中心化协调的同时，有效实现不同的DPF配置。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的基于AC的DPF场式框架成功地将估计逻辑与架构和协调关注点解耦，在统一的编程模型内系统性地衍生出不同的DPF配置(融合中心方案、完全去中心化方案等)。实验证明该方法在精度、通信成本和鲁棒性之间提供灵活的权衡空间，是面向开放IoT环境构建自适应DPF解决方案的有效抽象层。未来工作将探索空间自适应计算策略(如动态限制滤波范围)和多目标、异构传感模态下的分区估计。

title: Splaxel: Efficient Distributed Training of 3D Gaussian Splatting for Large-scale Scene Reconstruction via Pixel-level Communication
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables high-fidelity and real-time 3D scene reconstruction, but scaling training to large-scale scenes requires optimizing hundreds of millions of Gaussians across multiple GPUs. Existing distributed approaches either partition scenes into isolated regions, causing global inconsistency, or rely on global Gaussian-level exchanges, which lead to substantial growth in inter-GPU communication and quickly dominate iteration time. We propose Splaxel, a communication-efficient distributed 3DGS training framework based on pixel-level local rendering and global composition. Instead of synchronizing Gaussians, each GPU renders its local subset and exchanges only partial pixel values, maintaining mathematical consistency while keeping communication cost stable as the scene size increases. Splaxel further reduces pixel-level redundancy through geometric and transmittance visibility prediction and improves GPU utilization via conflict-free camera-view consolidation. Evaluated on large-scale datasets with up to 120M Gaussians, Splaxel achieves up to 7.6$\times$ speedup over the state-of-the-art distributed 3DGS framework while preserving high reconstruction quality.

AI.tldr: Splaxel 提出了一种基于像素级通信的高效分布式 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) 训练框架，通过局部渲染与全局合成、凸分区保证混合顺序、几何与透射率可见性预测消除像素冗余、无冲突视图合并提升 GPU 利用率，在包含最高 1.2 亿高斯的大规模场景上，相对现有 SOTA (Grendel) 实现最高 7.6× 加速且保持重建质量。
AI.motivation: 现有分布式 3DGS 训练存在两类瓶颈：(1) 算法层面将场景分区独立优化后会破坏全局一致性，产生可见接缝；(2) 系统层面（如 Grendel）采用高斯级 all-to-all 同步通信，通信量随高斯数和 GPU 数量非线性增长，很快主导迭代时间（8 GPU 下通信占比可达 73%-80%）。简单通过透明度阈值过滤高斯虽能减少通信，但会因视角相关的透明度差异引入跨视图不一致和明显渲染伪影。亟需一种通信量与高斯数量解耦、且不损失全局一致性的分布式训练方案。
AI.method: 核心思想是"以像素级通信替代高斯级通信"，各 GPU 渲染本地高斯子集得到局部像素（颜色+部分透射率+部分深度），通过 selective all-to-all 交换后按深度顺序全局合成，再将梯度局部反传。关键设计包括：(1) 凸分区（AABB/KD-tree 递归二分）保证每条相机射线至多与每个分区相交一次，从而维持全局混合顺序，无需额外通信即可拼接局部像素；(2) 空间冗余消除——在初始化阶段将视锥体与各凸分区的交集凸多面体顶点投影到图像平面，得到各 GPU 的可见像素掩码 Ω_v^m，仅交换重叠区域；(3) 饱和冗余消除——在全局合成时若累积透射率 < ε 即判为饱和，从该像素对应 GPU 集合中剔除后续分区，动态跳过冗余通信与渲染；(4) 无冲突视图合并调度器——按视图所跨 GPU 集合 P_v 贪心分桶，零交集视图并发执行，配合 FIFO 异步流水线重叠通信与计算；(5) 跨边界高斯逐射线过滤，消除相邻分区在重叠像素上的交错混合，使 PSNR 再提升 0.2–0.4 dB；(6) 周期性轻量级重分区（仅当不平衡 >20% 时触发，开销 <0.7%）。
AI.result: 在 MatrixCity 四个大规模数据集（Small/Big City Street 与 Aerial，最多 1.2 亿高斯、覆盖约 28 km²、35 万+6 万张图像）上，8 GPU 配置下：训练时间从 Grendel 的 48.8 h 降至 6.4 h（Big City Street，7.6×），PSNR 23.2 持平；Big City Aerial 从 3.6 h 降至 1.2 h（3.0×），PSNR 30.4→31.2；Small City Street 从 7.5 h 降至 1.3 h（5.8×），PSNR 21.4→21.7；Small City Aerial 从 25.5 min 降至 8.0 min（3.2×），PSNR 26.6→27.3。通信占比从 73%-80% 降至 10%-20%，每像素零像素比降低 39%-55%，饱和像素比降低 34%-40%，GPU 利用率提升 20%-35%，单 GPU 至 8 GPU 吞吐量持续线性扩展（Big City Street 达 90 img/s，Big City Aerial 达 142 img/s），消融实验显示各模块均贡献显著加速。
AI.conclusion: Splaxel 证明了像素级通信是分布式大规模 3DGS 训练的有效路径，其通信成本与高斯数解耦、与图像分辨率成正比；通过凸分区、可见性预测、饱和检测与无冲突视图合并等组合设计，在不牺牲全局一致性和重建质量的前提下，将通信从瓶颈位置移除并显著提升 GPU 利用率，为数十亿级高斯的大规模场景训练提供了可扩展的方案。

title: ShuntServe: Cost-Efficient LLM Serving on Heterogeneous Spot GPU Clusters
summary: As large language model (LLM) services become widely adopted, the cost of GPU resources for serving these models in cloud environments has emerged as a critical concern. Spot instances offer up to 90% cost savings over on-demand instances, but their frequent interruptions and limited availability pose significant challenges for continuous LLM serving. GPU spot instances, in particular, exhibit lower and more volatile availability than CPU-based instances, making homogeneous clusters that depend on a single GPU type vulnerable to correlated failures. Heterogeneous clusters spanning multiple GPU types can address this by leveraging complementary availability patterns across diverse spot pools, yet existing LLM serving systems are designed for homogeneous environments and suffer from load imbalance when deployed on heterogeneous GPUs. This paper presents ShuntServe, a cost-efficient LLM serving system for heterogeneous spot GPU clusters. ShuntServe employs a roofline model-based analytical serving performance estimator and a dynamic programming-based model placement optimizer that jointly determines node configuration, parallelization strategy, and layer assignment to maximize throughput across heterogeneous GPUs. To enhance fault tolerance when using spot instances, ShuntServe combines output-preserving request migration with concurrent initialization via a shared tensor store, minimizing migration downtime by overlapping replacement node preparation with ongoing serving. Evaluation on Llama-3.1-70B and Qwen3-32B with a heterogeneous AWS cluster of L4, A10G, and L40S GPUs shows that ShuntServe achieves 1.42x and 1.35x higher throughput than state-of-the-art baselines and attains 31.9% and 31.2% cost efficiency improvements over on-demand instances for offline and online serving, respectively.

AI.tldr: ShuntServe是一个面向异构Spot GPU集群的低成本大语言模型服务系统，通过基于roofline模型的性能估计器和动态编程的模型放置优化器，解决GPU spot实例中断频繁和异构环境下负载不均衡的问题，在Llama-3.1-70B和Qwen3-32B上实现比SOTA基线高1.42x和1.35x的吞吐量，以及31.9%和31.2%的成本效率提升。
AI.motivation: 云端LLM服务面临高昂的GPU资源成本问题，Spot实例虽可节省高达90%成本，但其频繁中断和有限可用性带来挑战。GPU spot实例的可用性低于且比CPU实例更不稳定，依赖单一GPU类型的同构集群容易因相关故障而瘫痪。异构集群虽能利用不同spot池的互补可用性，但现有LLM服务系统专为同构环境设计，在异构GPU上会出现负载不均衡问题。
AI.method: ShuntServe包含三大核心技术：(1) 基于roofline模型的解析式服务性能估计器，用于预测不同配置下的吞吐性能；(2) 基于动态规划的模型放置优化器，联合优化节点配置、并行策略和层分配，以最大化异构GPU上的吞吐量；(3) 容错机制——结合输出保持的请求迁移与通过共享tensor store实现的并发初始化，使替换节点准备与持续服务重叠，最小化迁移停机时间。
AI.result: 在由L4、A10G和L40S GPU组成的AWS异构集群上对Llama-3.1-70B和Qwen3-32B进行评估：吞吐量分别比SOTA基线提高1.42倍和1.35倍；离线服务和在线服务场景下，相对按需实例分别获得31.9%和31.2%的成本效率提升。
AI.conclusion: ShuntServe证明了通过异构spot GPU集群提供成本高效的LLM服务是可行的。其基于解析模型的性能估计与放置优化相结合的方案有效解决了异构环境下的负载均衡难题，而输出保持迁移与并发初始化机制显著降低了spot实例中断带来的服务中断影响，为云端LLM服务的成本优化提供了实用方案。

title: HI-HCQC: A Tightly-Coupled Hardware Interface with High-Efficiency Communication for Hybrid Classical-Quantum Computing
summary: Hybrid classical-quantum computing requires frequent data exchange between classical processors and quantum control hardware. However, existing superconducting quantum control systems are commonly connected through loosely coupled interfaces such as Ethernet, resulting in high communication latency and limited task throughput. To address this issue, we present HI-HCQC, an RFSoC-based hardware interface for tightly coupled hybrid classical-quantum computing. HI-HCQC integrates high-speed RF-DACs, RF-ADCs, programmable logic, embedded processors, clock synchronization circuits, and a PCIe Gen3 x8 interface, enabling direct microwave pulse synthesis, qubit readout, and high-throughput data transfer between host servers and quantum measurement-control units. Experimental results show that HI-HCQC supports six control channels and one multiplexed readout channel, achieves stable microwave generation and acquisition, and successfully performs qubit spectroscopy, Rabi oscillation, T1 measurement, single-shot readout, randomized benchmarking, and CZ-gate characterization. Compared with a conventional control system, HI-HCQC reduces end-to-end execution latency for representative quantum gate and circuit tasks and significantly improves task throughput. These results demonstrate that PCIe-coupled RFSoC control hardware provides a practical foundation for scalable and efficient hybrid classical-quantum computing systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HI-HCQC，一种基于RFSoC的紧耦合经典-量子混合计算硬件接口。该系统通过集成高速RF-DAC/RF-ADC、可编程逻辑、嵌入式处理器、时钟同步电路以及PCIe Gen3 x8接口，实现了主机服务器与量子测控单元之间的高吞吐量数据传输和直接微波脉冲合成/读出，相比传统以太网松耦合方案显著降低了端到端执行延迟并提升了任务吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 当前超导量子计算控制系统多通过以太网等松耦合接口与经典处理器相连，导致通信延迟高、任务吞吐量有限，难以满足混合经典-量子计算对频繁数据交换的需求，亟需一种紧耦合、低延迟、高吞吐的硬件接口方案。
AI.method: 设计并实现HI-HCQC硬件接口：基于RFSoC芯片集成高速RF-DAC（用于微波脉冲合成）和RF-ADC（用于量子比特读出）、可编程逻辑与嵌入式处理器，并加入时钟同步电路；通过PCIe Gen3 x8接口实现与主机服务器的直连高速数据传输。该系统支持6路控制通道和1路复用读出通道。
AI.result: 实验验证HI-HCQC可稳定生成和采集微波信号，成功执行量子比特光谱、Rabi振荡、T1测量、单发读出、随机化基准测试以及CZ门表征等典型量子实验。相比传统控制系统，在代表性量子门和线路任务上的端到端执行延迟显著降低，任务吞吐量大幅提升。
AI.conclusion: 基于RFSoC并以PCIe紧耦合的量子控制硬件为可扩展、高效的混合经典-量子计算系统提供了切实可行的基础架构。

title: Re-Rooting-Based Fault-Tolerant One-to-All Broadcasting in Dense Eisenstein--Jacobi Networks
comment: Preprint also available on Zenodo: this https URL
summary: Dense Eisenstein--Jacobi networks are degree-six algebraic interconnection topologies with regular structure, vertex symmetry, small diameter, and efficient communication algorithms. These properties make them suitable for parallel and on-chip communication systems in which collective operations such as one-to-all broadcasting are frequent. Existing optimal broadcasting algorithms for dense hexagonal/Eisenstein--Jacobi networks assume fault-free operation. However, a faulty internal forwarding node may interrupt message propagation and prevent complete delivery. This paper proposes a lightweight re-rooting-based fault-tolerant broadcasting method for dense Eisenstein--Jacobi networks. The main idea is to relocate the effective broadcast source to a new source node such that each faulty node is located at graph distance equal to the network diameter from the new source. Consequently, faulty nodes become leaf-level nodes in the broadcast process and are not required to forward the message. We present source-selection algorithms for one- and two-node failures and prove that for any pair of faulty nodes in a dense Eisenstein--Jacobi network there exists a common distance-diameter node that can serve as a valid re-rooted source. The source-selection procedure requires linear time in the network diameter. Equivalently, since $N=3t^2+3t+1$, the selection cost is $O(\sqrt{N})$ in the number of nodes. Since the standard one-to-all broadcast completes in one diameter time and the relocation phase is also bounded by one diameter, the proposed method completes in at most twice the network diameter. We also show that the two-fault guarantee does not generally extend to arbitrary three-fault configurations by giving an explicit counterexample. The proposed approach improves broadcast reliability without constructing redundant spanning trees, backup paths, or additional broadcast structures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于"重新选根"（re-rooting）的轻量级容错广播方法，用于密集Eisenstein-Jacobi（EJ）六度代数互联网络。其核心思想是将有效广播源重新定位到一个新节点，使所有故障节点恰好处于距新源等于网络直径t的边界位置，从而在标准广播树中变为叶节点，无需转发消息。论文证明了对任意单节点或双节点故障均存在这样的新源（基于"边界差覆盖"性质B_t - B_t = H_n），源选择算法的时间复杂度为O(t)=O(√N)，总广播时间上界为2t。同时通过H_4中的反例证明该保证不能推广到任意三节点故障。
AI.motivation: 现有的密集EJ网络最优广播算法假设无故障运行，但内部转发节点故障会中断消息传播并阻止完整交付。传统的容错广播方法（如冗余生成树、备份路径、自适应重路由）要么构建额外的数据结构，要么需要运行时动态调整，增加了路由表存储、控制开销和实现复杂度。因此需要一种轻量级、确定性的容错机制，能够保持原始广播算法不变的同时处理节点故障。
AI.method: 方法基于一个关键观察：EJ网络中标准广播树在距离源t（网络直径）处的节点是叶节点，不再需要转发消息。因此如果能将故障节点重新"放置"到新源的t距离边界上，就可以直接复用原始广播算法而不做任何修改。技术路线包括：(1) 故障分类——区分故障节点是否已在t边界上；(2) 源选择——单故障情况下从故障节点的t边界集合B_t(F_1)中选取新源；双故障情况下需要找到B_t(F_1)∩B_t(F_2)∩B_t的公共节点；(3) 关键引理"边界差覆盖"（Lemma 1）证明对任意节点A∈H_n都存在U,V∈B_t使A=U-V，从而保证双故障下公共新源的存在；(4) 重新选根后，从原源S到新源NS进行消息中转（≤t步），再从NS执行标准广播（t步）。
AI.result: 理论结果：(1) 证明对任意双故障配置存在共同的t距离新源（Theorem 1）；(2) 给出H_4中三故障反例（节点0、5、14的三边界交集为空），证明该保证不能推广到任意三节点故障；(3) 源选择复杂度O(t)=O(√N)，总广播时间≤2t。实验结果（5种网络规模N=331到120601，每种规模2种故障场景×4种故障放置模式×1000次试验=40000次试验）：(1) 边界差覆盖性质在所有测试规模上均成立（|B_t - B_t| = N）；(2) 所提方法在所有单/双故障配置下均达到100%投递率，而基线方法成功率随网络规模增大从9.125%降至0.225%；(3) 所提方法到达节点数标准差为0，运行时间毫秒级；(4) 平均重定位跳数约为0.73t，平均检查候选数最多约152（≤6t=1200）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为密集EJ网络提供了一种轻量级、确定性的容错广播方案，对单/双节点故障具有完整保障，且无需构建冗余生成树、备份路径或修改广播算法。核心贡献是基于"边界差覆盖"性质证明双故障下公共新源的存在性，并以H_4反例明确了方法的理论边界（三节点故障不成立）。该方法特别适用于NoC芯片多处理器、多核加速器等对可预测通信和低实现开销有较高要求的规则拓扑系统。未来工作包括将方法扩展到链路故障、动态故障以及可接受公共边界重定位的特殊三类故障配置。

title: Closed-Form and Constant-Time New-Source Selection for Fault-Tolerant Broadcasting in Dense Eisenstein--Jacobi Networks
comment: Preprint also available on Zenodo: this https URL
summary: Fault-tolerant broadcasting in dense Eisenstein--Jacobi networks requires efficient recovery when faulty nodes disrupt the original broadcast structure. A re-rooting-based method guarantees that, for any two faulty nodes, a valid new source exists at maximum graph distance from both faults. However, identifying such a source without scanning the network or testing all boundary candidates remains an open practical problem. This paper presents a closed-form, constant-time algorithm for counting and selecting a valid new source in dense Eisenstein--Jacobi networks under two node faults. The two-fault problem is reduced to a boundary-intersection problem involving the origin and a difference node. The distance-$t$ boundary, where $t$ is the network diameter, is partitioned into six directed sides of the Eisenstein--Jacobi hexagon. Since the network is a quotient structure, intersection equations are solved modulo the defining lattice, requiring evaluation of seven quotient-lattice shifts across all $6\times 6$ side pairs, yielding at most $252$ algebraic systems. The first algorithm counts all valid new sources for faults at $0$ and $A$. The second algorithm selects one valid new source for arbitrary fault pairs by solving translated side-pair systems, verifying each candidate, and shifting back. Each system is either a non-parallel $2\times 2$ linear system with at most one candidate, or a parallel system whose feasible candidates form an integer interval. Both algorithms run in $O(1)$ time under the fixed-word arithmetic model. Computational validation over $500{,}000$ sampled fault pairs and $40{,}000$ re-rooting trials confirms correctness: the selector always returns a valid new source, and the recovered broadcast reaches all non-faulty nodes.

AI.tldr: 本文针对密集Eisenstein–Jacobi网络中两个节点故障的容错广播问题，提出了一种闭式、常数时间的新源点计数与选择算法。该算法将双故障源点选择问题转化为商格边界相交问题，通过在七种商格平移下求解36对六边形边对的代数系统（至多252个），在固定字长算术模型下实现O(1)时间复杂度，并通过50万故障对采样和4万次重根广播实验验证了正确性。
AI.motivation: 在密集Eisenstein–Jacobi网络（EJ_t）中，已有的重根（re-rooting）容错广播方法证明：对于任意两个故障节点，必存在一个与两故障点距离均为直径t的新源点，使广播可恢复。然而，如何在不扫描整个网络或测试所有边界候选节点的情况下，直接定位这样的新源点仍是一个未解决的实践问题。现有方法需扫描6t个边界节点，复杂度为O(t)，在网络规模增大时效率受限。
AI.method: 1. **平移归约**：利用距离的平移不变性，将任意双故障A、B归约为原点和差节点C = mod(B−A)的问题，找到P后通过NS = mod(A+P)还原。2. **六边形边界划分**：将距离为t的边界B_t划分为6条有向边S_1,…,S_6，每条含t个节点，端点采用半开约定使划分不相交。3. **商格平移**：通过有限移位充分性引理，证明双故障边界相交只需考虑7种商格平移K_t = {0, ±L_1, ±L_2, ±L_3}。4. **平移边对方程**：对每个(L, i, j)三元组，建立2×2线性方程M_ij [s, u]^T = X + V_j + L − V_i；非平行系统用Cramer法则求解（至多1个候选），平行系统转化为整数区间计数。5. **算法1（计数）**：对0和A故障，遍历252个系统求和得到有效新源点精确数量；**算法2（选择）**：遍历252个系统，找到首个满足距离验证的候选点即返回。6. **复杂度**：固定字长模型下均为O(1)时间，与t和N无关。
AI.result: 1. **计数算法**：在t=10、25、50下穷举验证以及t=100、200下采样10000节点验证中，算法1的输出与暴力边界扫描完全一致，零错误。2. **选择算法**：在t∈{10,25,50,100,200}上对50万采样故障对进行测试，所有返回的源点均满足与两故障点距离均为t的距离条件，零失败。3. **重根恢复性能**：在随机、近距离、关键、近对四种故障模式下共4万次试验中，单故障和双故障均实现100%恢复，覆盖N−f个非故障节点（f为故障数）；基线广播树成功率仅0.25%–8.075%。4. **运行效率**：t=200时，算法2相比边界扫描方法实现约9.80倍加速，且直接选择平均仅检查约9.76个候选（远小于252的理论上界），最大检查数为21。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过将双故障源点选择问题严格转化为六边形边对商格相交问题，提供了首个自包含的闭式、常数时间算法，在不进行网络或边界扫描的前提下完成有效新源点的计数与选择。该工作是对已有Eisenstein–Jacobi重根广播框架的算法级增强（而非替代），明确了"边对平移系统"这一固定规模求解结构是其常数时间性质的几何根源。固定开销使其在大直径网络中优势显著（t=200时加速约10倍）。未来工作包括按恢复代价对多候选排序、与完整广播流程的集成，以及将该固定情形构造推广到更大故障集或其他代数网络族。

title: Closed-Form and Constant-Time New-Source Selection for Fault-Tolerant Broadcasting in Dense Gaussian Networks
comment: Preprint also available on Zenodo: https: this https URL
summary: Fault-tolerant broadcasting in dense Gaussian networks is recovered by re-rooting the broadcast at a new source at maximum graph distance from the faulty nodes. This paper extends the re-rooting framework by replacing its boundary-search source-selection step with a quotient-lattice-aware algebraic construction. The first contribution is a constant-time counting method for valid new sources, formulated as an intersection of two diameter-$k$ boundary sets in the Gaussian quotient. The exact count is obtained by a fixed union of side-pair intervals over nine quotient-lattice copies, giving a closed-form procedure without scanning the network or boundary. The second contribution is a shifted direct selector for two arbitrary faulty nodes. Given faulty nodes $A$ and $B$, the problem is translated to $C=\operatorname{mod}_{G_k}(B-A)$, and the selector finds $P$ satisfying $d(P,0)=d(P,C)=k$. For each of nine quotient-lattice shifts, sixteen signed linear systems are checked. Nonparallel systems are solved via Cramer's rule; parallel systems are handled by interval-endpoint selection. At most $9\times16=144$ shifted sign cases are evaluated, giving $O(1)$ selection under the word-RAM model. Validation reports zero count mismatches over $26{,}623$ tested nodes, $500{,}000$ valid outputs over $500{,}000$ sampled fault pairs, and $40{,}000$ successful re-rooted broadcast trials. The shifted selector achieves a $5.92\times$ speedup over boundary search at $k=200$, remaining stable as $k$ increases. These results make new-source selection algebraic, bounded, and independent of network size.

AI.tldr: 本文针对密集高斯网络中基于重根的容错广播方法，提出了一种代数化的、闭式、常数时间的新源选择算法，替代原O(k)边界搜索方法。通过商格意识的构造，在9×16=144个代数情形中实现O(1)选择，并通过大量计算验证。
AI.motivation: 现有的重根容错广播框架在选择新源时依赖O(k)的边界搜索或仅证明存在性，缺乏直接闭式方法。这种依赖网络扫描的方法掩盖了问题的代数结构，且恢复成本随网络规模增长。需要一种不扫描网络、运行时间独立于网络规模的代数选择方法。
AI.method: 将两故障节点A、B的新源选择问题转化为等价问题：找点P满足d(P,0)=d(P,C)=k，其中C=mod_{G_k}(B-A)。利用9个商格偏移和16种符号配置（最多144个代数情形），非平行系统用Cramer法则求解，平行系统用区间端点选择。在word-RAM模型下实现O(1)选择。计数方面，将有效新源表示为两个直径-k边界集的交集，通过9个商格副本上的边对区间并集给出闭式公式。
AI.result: 计数公式验证：26,623个测试节点零计数失配。选择算法验证：500,000个采样故障对全部输出有效新源。广播恢复验证：40,000次试验100%成功恢复N-f个无故障节点。运行时性能：k=200时获得5.92×加速比，且运行时间随k增长保持稳定。理论最大144个代数情形，实际最大仅51个。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功将新源选择过程从O(k)边界搜索转变为O(1)代数构造，使选择过程有界、独立于网络大小。理论保证和计算验证均证实了方法的正确性与效率。商格意识的技术框架可推广至其他代数互连网络。未来工作可包括多候选源排名、链路故障扩展、动态故障处理等。

title: ReMP: Low-Downtime Runtime Model-Parallelism Reconfiguration for LLM Serving
summary: Current large language model (LLM) inference systems universally deploy ultra-large-scale models using a combination of Tensor Parallelism (TP) and Pipeline Parallelism (PP). However, existing systems treat the model parallelism topology as a static configuration that cannot be flexibly adjusted at runtime. This rigid design creates a fundamental contradiction with the dynamically changing inference workloads in real-world scenarios. State-of-the-art systems lack online reconfiguration capabilities and can only switch configurations by restarting the service, resulting in several minutes of service interruption, KV cache loss, and prohibitive recomputation overhead. To address this problem, this paper presents ReMP, a runtime model parallelism reconfiguration framework that supports low downtime. ReMP achieves dynamic adjustment through three key techniques: (1) decoupling the model parallelism topology from runtime state to avoid full service reconstruction; (2) designing a two-dimensional KV cache migration mechanism to preserve reusable cache states after TP/PP changes; and (3) implementing end-to-end online reconfiguration. Experiments demonstrate that ReMP can complete most topology switches within 1-7 seconds on models ranging from 7B to 70B parameters, achieving speedups of tens to over a hundred times compared to the restart approach. Moreover, ReMP significantly outperforms fixed configurations under dynamic workloads, delivering superior performance in terms of TTFT, TPOT, and output throughput.

AI.tldr: ReMP 是一个面向大语言模型（LLM）推理服务的运行时模型并行拓扑重配置框架，能够在秒级时间内（1-7秒）动态调整张量并行（TP）和流水线并行（PP）配置，避免传统重启方式带来的数分钟服务中断、KV缓存丢失和大量重计算开销，相比重启方式可获得数十倍至超过100倍的加速，并在动态负载下显著优化 TTFT、TPOT 和吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 当前 LLM 推理系统普遍使用 TP+PP 部署超大模型，但将并行拓扑视为静态启动配置，无法在运行时灵活调整。然而真实生产环境中，LLM 推理流量呈现明显的周期性波动（如昼夜变化），低负载时最优拓扑（高 TP、低 PP 降低单请求延迟）与高负载时最优拓扑（高 PP、低 TP 提升吞吐）截然不同。这种静态拓扑与动态负载之间存在根本矛盾，而现有系统只能通过重启服务来切换配置，导致数分钟中断、KV 缓存丢弃和大量 prefill 重计算，使动态调整实际不可行。
AI.method: ReMP 通过三个关键技术实现低停机时间重配置：(1) **拓扑与运行时状态解耦**——在 CPU 共享内存中持久化完整模型状态字典，通过预构建的 MPU 状态快照（MPU State Space）管理多种候选拓扑的通信组，通过 worker 的 standby/wakeup 机制避免进程销毁重建；(2) **二维 KV 缓存迁移机制**——同时沿 PP 维度（层归属）和 TP 维度（KV-head 归属）进行重映射，采用分层流式迁移（layer-wise streaming）控制峰值内存开销，并通过局部拷贝和 P2P 远程传输混合策略减少跨卡通信量；(3) **事务化重配置流程**——将切换建模为受控事务，定义一致性边界和提交点（commit point），并通过将模型分片重建与 KV 缓存迁移并发执行来缩短关键路径（critical path），即 T_switch^overlap = T_worker + T_mpu + max(T_kv, T_model) + T_sched。系统深度集成于 vLLM v1 中。
AI.result: 在 8×H100 和 8×RTX 5090 两套平台上，使用 4 个 7B-70B 的模型（Llama2-7B/70B、Qwen3-30B-A3B、DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B）进行评估：**重配置成本方面**，ReMP 大多数拓扑切换在 1-7 秒内完成（Llama2-7B 约 1-2 秒，70B 模型数秒），相比 restart 基线获得数十倍加速，多次超过 100 倍；模型重建与 KV 缓存迁移的并发执行有效减少了状态转换时间。**服务性能方面**，相比 TP1PP8 和 TP2PP4 两种固定配置基线，ReMP 通过在不同负载下动态选择最优拓扑，在 TTFT、TPOT 和输出吞吐量三个指标上均表现更优，70B 模型上优势尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: ReMP 证明了将模型并行拓扑从静态启动参数转变为运行时可调资源的可行性。它将传统上需数分钟的服务重建问题转化为内存中的状态转换问题，为现代 LLM 推理系统提供了自适应服务的基础。在动态负载场景下，ReMP 不仅大幅降低切换成本，更能持续优于固定配置部署，是实现自适应 LLM serving 的实用框架。

title: Compressed-Resident Genomics: Full-Pipeline Device-Resident GPU LZ77 Decode with Position-Invariant Random Access
comment: 5 pages, 3 tables. ACEAPEX and aceapex_cuda included in lzbench 2.3
summary: Genomic archives grow faster than decompression keeps up: the European Nucleotide Archive holds tens of petabytes of this http URL , and gzip is fundamentally sequential. GPU decompressors (nvCOMP DEFLATE at ~50GB/s on A100) decode whole files with no random access; CPU genomic tools (CRAM, samtools) support region seeks but only at CPU speed. We extend ACEAPEX, an absolute-offset parallel LZ77 codec included in the official lzbench 2.3 release, with three contributions absent from our prior work. First, a full device-resident GPU decode pipeline (entropy and match resolution both on-device) reaching up to 260GB/s on FASTQ, closing the match-phase-only gap of the earlier paper. Second, position-invariant random access with a compact coordinate index: an arbitrary read decodes in 0.362ms, ~6x faster than warm samtools faidx, with a read-to-block index 6.3x smaller than a .fai. Third, a range-decode strategy that decouples output size from VRAM, sustaining 165.7GB/s on a 50GB genome where whole-file decode runs out of memory. All results are bit-perfect. We also measure Meta's open DietGPU ANS on H100 at 592GB/s decode, faster than the proprietary entropy stage we currently use, showing a fully open high-throughput stack is viable. Code is MIT-licensed.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了ACEAPEX（一种绝对偏移并行LZ77编解码器），提出三项GPU基因组解压贡献：(1) 完整的设备常驻GPU解码流水线，在FASTQ上达到260 GB/s；(2) 位置不变的随机访问，任意读段0.362 ms解码，比热samtools faidx快约6倍；(3) 范围解码策略，解耦输出大小与VRAM，在50 GB基因组上保持165.7 GB/s。目标是实现"压缩常驻基因组学"，使整个基因组可压缩存放在VRAM中并支持亚毫秒级随机访问。
AI.motivation: 测序数据量（如欧洲核苷酸档案库达数十PB的fastq.gz）已超过解压吞吐能力：gzip本质上是顺序流；现有GPU解压器（nvCOMP DEFLATE约50 GB/s）仅支持整文件解压且无随机访问；CPU基因组工具（CRAM、samtools）支持区域寻址但速度仅CPU级，无法喂给GPU常驻分析流水线。这是测序-分析流程中的结构性瓶颈。
AI.method: 基于ACEAPEX的绝对偏移LZ77格式：每个反向引用在编码时解析为解压输出的绝对位置，使每个固定大小块（本文用16 KB）自包含、可独立解码。提出两种GPU模式：Mode 1（lzbench 2.3中开源版本，CPU做熵解码、GPU做匹配解析）；Mode 2（使用nvcomp ANS在GPU做熵解码，完全设备常驻）。位置不变的随机访问通过只解码覆盖目标区域的块实现，并构建read-to-block紧凑索引。范围解码分块处理归档，永不物化完整输出。实验平台为NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 + CUDA 12.8。
AI.result: 在H100上：Mode 1主机到主机解码4.4 GB/s，比单线程CPU快1.75-2.4倍；Mode 2设备常驻FASTQ NA12878 1GB达260 GB/s（熵阶段约480 GB/s，匹配阶段约203 GB/s），50GB ERR194147经范围解码达165.7 GB/s。随机访问：单块寻址0.365 ms，比完整解码快81倍；单read端到端0.362 ms，比热samtools快约6倍，索引比.fai小6.3倍。DietGPU开源ANS在H100上达到592 GB/s，超过专有nvcomp-ANS。诚实端到端（含PCIe）解码26 GB/s，D2H为瓶颈（39 GB/s）。压缩比不是最优：zstd-19比ACEAPEX密1.2-1.55倍。所有结果均bit-perfect。
AI.conclusion: 绝对偏移LZ77格式支持完整的设备常驻GPU解码、位置不变的随机访问和解耦VRAM的范围解码，使"压缩常驻基因组学"成为可能：50 GB基因组压缩至12.7 GB可存放于80 GB VRAM中（占16%），任意区域亚毫秒级解码，超越约39 GB/s的D2H上限。DietGPU测量表明剩余的专有熵阶段可被开源方案替代，该集成是下一步工作。代码MIT许可，存档于Zenodo。

title: Urban Limits as Design Constraints: Identifying Suitable Locations for Distributed, Photovoltaic-Powered Servers
comment: Paper in Proceedings of LIMITS 2026: 12th Workshop on Computing within Limits, 2026-06-23-25, Online
summary: Urban territories face growing tensions between increasing digital demand, limited resources, and socially constrained built environments. Although distributed computing paradigms such as edge and fog computing are widely presented as solutions for reducing latency and energy dissipation, the scientific literature largely overlooks where such infrastructures can be physically and socially deployed within cities, and typically neglects urban constraints, environmental impacts, and equity considerations. This paper proposes a methodology for identifying suitable urban locations for deploying distributed servers under structural, environmental, and social limits. Relying exclusively on existing infrastructures and anthropised surfaces, it combines legal frameworks, ongoing urban projects, citizen consultations, and scientific literature to construct a place-based glossary of viable site typologies, evaluated through energy, spatial, and qualitative criteria. Applied to the French city of Montpellier, our results illustrate how urban constraints and local resources shape the feasibility of decentralised, solar-powered digital infrastructures, and highlight the value of territorialised approaches for rethinking digital services within urban limits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种在结构、环境和社会约束下识别城市中适合部署分布式光伏供电服务器位置的方法论,并以法国蒙彼利埃为案例,将其应用于支持高中教育中的大语言模型(LLM)使用场景。
AI.motivation: 边缘计算和雾计算虽被广泛视为降低延迟和能耗的方案,但现有研究多将其视为算法优化问题,忽视了城市部署中的物理、社会和环境约束,缺乏系统性的城市选址框架。数字基础设施的扩张带来了土地人工化、能源消耗和社会公平等问题,需要在城市有限性(urban limits)的视角下重新思考数字服务的部署方式。
AI.method: 方法包含两步:第一步通过法律法规、城市项目、公民咨询和科学文献四个来源识别候选位置,构建"场地类型词汇表",并依据材料兼容性、结构规范、规格明确性和数据可获得性四项标准筛选;第二步从能源(光伏产能)、空间(与需求的距离)和质量(环境改造与部署可接受性)三个维度对场地进行表征和分级。能源产能估算结合晴空辐照模型、云量系数和阴影因子。
AI.result: 在蒙彼利埃案例中,从16种场地类型中筛选出8种具备能源可行性。其中服务建筑(如学校屋顶)、单户住宅、多户住宅和停车场可在500米内满足全部LLM能源需求;服务建筑尤其因属公共建筑而最优。工业建筑、体育建筑、路灯和污染土地需要超过1公里距离。最终推荐部署于市政所有的服务建筑上,利用Genesis原型(集成光伏面板的户外服务器)运行Llama 3.1 8B模型。
AI.conclusion: 分布式、光伏供电的数字基础设施可通过再利用现有城市空间实现环境和社会可接受的部署,体现"数字节制"理念。方法具有情境化特征,需根据当地数据、法规和城市形态调整。未来研究方向包括:将方法与经典优化框架结合、采用Pareto前沿等多目标评估方式、追踪城市动态变化下的长期适用性,以及与利益相关者开展探索性访谈以共同定义可持续的数字需求。

title: LiveStack: OS Support for Cluster-Scale Full-Stack Live Simulation
summary: Cluster-scale full-stack simulation is essential for evaluating distributed software stacks and emerging hardware components before deployment. Such simulation must achieve both full-stack fidelity for the unmodified production stack and the simulation performance required for iterative configuration exploration. However, no existing method achieves both. We present LiveStack, an OS-level approach to cluster-scale full-stack simulation built on top of the Linux virtualization stack. LiveStack comprises four subsystems: simulation-oriented scheduling, live memory hierarchy management, simulation-aware IPC, and distributed simulation orchestration. Together, they coordinate live and modeled components under shared simulated time while controlling interference among co-located live hosts. These mechanisms point toward simulation-native OS support, where simulation control and orchestration become core OS responsibilities.

AI.tldr: LiveStack 提出了一种基于 Linux 虚拟化栈的操作系统级方法,通过在 KVM/QEMU 之上引入四个子系统(模拟导向调度、内存层级管理、模拟感知 IPC、分布式编排),实现集群规模的全栈保真与高仿真性能兼得,为"模拟原生 OS 支持"开辟新方向。
AI.motivation: 集群规模全栈仿真需要同时满足两个属性:① 全栈保真性(无源码修改地运行生产栈,跨层保持真实交互);② 仿真性能(支持迭代式配置探索)。现有方法各有缺陷:离散事件仿真器(gem5、ns-3)只针对单层;模块化组合框架(SimBricks/SplitSim)受限于最慢组件;现有活体仿真(Phantora、NEX)只针对特定负载或不具备全栈兼容性,均无法同时满足两大需求。
AI.method: LiveStack 以 Linux 虚拟化栈(KVM+QEMU+libvirt)作为活体执行底座,设计了四个 OS 级子系统,围绕"保活体执行、让 OS 具备模拟感知"原则构建:① 模拟导向调度——基于 vtask 抽象与时钟派生/模型驱动的虚拟时间(vtime)记账,通过可配置同步作用域(skew bound)控制活体与建模组件的虚拟时间偏差,并正确处理阻塞 vtask 的时间因果性;② 活体内存层级管理——通过 cell 抽象封装 cpuset/CAT/MBA/NUMA 等资源,对并发活体主机做空间隔离(独立 cell)与时间残差校正(cell 切换时清洗缓存/预取工作集,并通过 PMU 采样补偿);③ 模拟感知 IPC——以 message/endpoint/hub 抽象分离时序控制与数据搬运,内核 hub 提供轻量路由与时延控制,消息按可见时间排序入队,eBPF 钩子支持扩展;④ 分布式仿真编排——通过每机守护进程+内核支持,把远端 vtask 表示为本地代理,逻辑 hub 跨机分布,数据面留在内核热路径上以降低跨机协调开销。
AI.result: 原型在单机 1–3 个 KVM VM 组成的星形拓扑上,以硬件以太网交换机物理测试床为对照进行评估。性能方面,TPC-C 负载 90.4 秒完成,而同等模块化 gem5 设置一周内未完成;CoreMark 仅 1.1× 减速,Spark TPC-DS 99 减速最大 4.0×,减速随同步实例数增加而上升。准确度方面,各负载相对物理测试床的指标准确率介于 72.7%(Spark TPC-DS 99 运行时间)至 97.8%(CoreMark 算术速度)之间,TPC-C 吞吐准确率 92.3%。内存层级干扰、IPC 可见性时机等剩余误差源尚未完全控制,但初步结果验证了 LiveStack 的可行性与显著性能优势。
AI.conclusion: LiveStack 将仿真控制与编排下沉为 OS 核心职责,初步验证了集群规模全栈活体仿真的可行性与显著性能优势,作者将其定位为迈向"模拟原生 OS 支持"(simulation-native OS support)这一更广泛方向的第一步,未来可扩展至非 KVM 虚拟化技术(如 GPU 设备),为分布式软件栈与新兴硬件的部署前评估提供统一平台。

title: A Composable CRDT Layer for Byzantine-Resilient Deterministic Reconstruction
summary: Conflict-free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs) ensure Strong Eventual Consistency without coordination, but typically assume benign participants and rely on validation or exclusion to handle Byzantine behavior. We address this problem through deterministic state reconstruction: rather than deciding which updates are admissible, all accepted updates are incorporated, while only a subset contributes to the reconstructed state. We instantiate this approach in Melda, a non-intrusive delta-state CRDT for JSON documents, and show that its reconstruction model guarantees convergence even under arbitrary update injection: adversarial updates are either structurally rejected or treated as inputs to the reconstruction process. We formalize this model and prove that replicas deriving state from the same set of updates cannot diverge despite equivocation, omission, or message reordering. We further show that authentication, authorization, and confidentiality can be layered without affecting convergence. Overall, this approach suggests that Byzantine tolerance can be achieved by decoupling update propagation from state derivation, allowing agreement on updates to be handled independently by external dissemination or consensus mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于确定性状态重建的拜占庭容错CRDT设计新范式，通过将更新传播与状态推导解耦，使所有接受到的更新都被纳入，但仅有一部分决定重建状态。该方法在Melda（一个用于JSON文档的非侵入式delta-state CRDT）中实现，证明了在任意更新注入、equivocation、omission和消息重排序等拜占庭行为下，正确副本仍能保证收敛。
AI.motivation: 传统CRDT设计假设良性参与者，依靠验证或排除机制处理拜占庭行为，但在开放去中心化环境中恶意节点可能注入畸形、冲突或恶意更新，导致副本发散。Kleppmann等人已证明传统CRDT在拜占庭行为下无法保证收敛。本文旨在探索一种不依赖全局有效性验证或中心化过滤的替代方案，通过确定性状态重建实现拜占庭容错。
AI.method: 1. **Melda CRDT模型**：基于grow-only集合C的不变JSON对象集合，每个对象由稳定ID标识，版本通过密码学哈希寻址，形成修订树；通过确定性算法选择winning revision。2. **Delta块传播**：更新编码为内容寻址的delta块，引用锚点（因果依赖），通过单调递增索引N = max(anchor indices) + 1保证依赖图无环。3. **确定性验证与适用性**：验证仅依赖delta块内容、哈希、声明锚点及数据包的可用性与完整性；适用性由验证结果和锚点是否已应用决定，二者均为确定性函数。4. **状态重建**：从根对象出发递归解析引用，仅因果可达的修订参与重建，采用可组合的adapter模式（装饰器模式）集成melda-sec安全扩展（签名验证、策略授权、加密）。5. **形式化证明**：通过5个引理（确定性验证、确定性适用性、无环性、确定性状态、信任配置一致性）证明核心定理——观察相同更新集U的两个正确副本必然推导出相同状态。
AI.result: 理论结果：（1）拜占庭行为（equivocation、omission、消息重排序、任意更新注入）不会导致正确副本发散；（2）更新要么被所有副本拒绝，要么被确定性纳入重建过程，呈现全有或全无语义；（3）melda-sec作为有效性谓词的精化，可在不破坏收敛性的前提下实现认证、授权和机密性；（4）确定性重建与上层分发/共识机制正交，可独立组合。实验层面：论文以形式化证明为主，未报告具体的性能基准测试，但讨论了与现有方法（Kleppmann的验证方法、Jacob的equivocation容忍、Blocklace、SRDT）的对比定位——Melda采用"通过投影忽略"而非"接受/拒绝"或"中心化过滤"的策略。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了拜占庭容错可通过将更新传播与状态推导解耦来实现，而非仅依赖更新准入性的全局一致。Melda展示了这一范式在实际JSON文档复制中的可行性，其非侵入式设计和可组合的adapter架构使其能与各种分发机制（中心化存储、gossip协议、共识机制）正交组合。收敛性被分解为两个正交属性：对更新集的共识和对更新的确定性解释。未来工作包括集成点对点gossip分发、评估去中心化环境中的角色授权、丰富加密原语及对抗性工作负载下的性能研究。

title: On the Notions of Bounded Bypass, and How to Make any Deadlock-Free MUTEX Protocol Satisfy One of Them
summary: In the literature on mutual exclusion, bounded bypass has been used for a long time as a strengthening of starvation-freedom, but, to the best of our knowledge, it still lacks a satisfying definition as a liveness property on its own. Moreover, we have encountered MUTEX protocols for which this notion needs to be slightly weakened in order to be met. To solve these issues, we first provide a formal definition of bounded bypass (that also corrects a previous definition from Raynal) and then introduce the notions of post-doorway and intermittent bounded bypass, two liveness properties that lie between starvation-freedom and bounded bypass. Essentially, intermittent bounded bypass weakens bounded bypass by ignoring the possible bypasses that may happen during the execution of a certain finite set of write operations to shared registers. Orthogonally, post-doorway bounded bypass ignores the bypasses that may happen during a finite initial phase of the lock protocol. Furthermore, we study an algorithm proposed by Yoah Bar-David in 1998 to enhance the liveness properties of any deadlock-free MUTEX protocol and prove that: (1) in the setting of atomic registers, this algorithm upgrades any deadlock-free mutual exclusion protocol to a bounded bypass one, with a bound that is quadratic in the number of processes; and (2) in the setting of safe and regular registers, the very same algorithm ensures the intermittent version of bounded bypass, still with a quadratic (but slightly different) bound. Finally, we provide logical formulae for the different notions of bounded bypass defined in this paper and use them to confirm all claims made here, by using model checking. This had a positive impact on the theoretical development of the work, since it allowed us to identify and correct small mistakes/ambiguities in definitions and proofs.

AI.tldr: 本文针对互斥协议中的"有界旁路"(bounded bypass)性质给出了严格的形式化定义，修正了Raynal定义中的两处错误；提出了两种弱化版本——后入口段(post-doorway)有界旁路和间歇(intermittent)有界旁路；并证明Bar-David 1998年算法可将任意无死锁互斥协议升级为(间歇)有界旁路协议，在原子寄存器下界为n(n-1)-1，在安全/正规寄存器下界为n²-2。最后用mCRL2模型检测验证了所有结论。
AI.motivation: 有界旁路作为互斥协议中强化无饥饿性的经典性质，长期缺乏作为独立活性(liveness)属性的严格形式化定义。Raynal的定义存在两个错误：(1)未要求调用lock的进程最终进入临界区，导致有界旁路不能蕴含无饥饿性；(2)未指明从何时起开始计算旁路次数，导致无协议能真正满足。此外，已知存在需要弱化定义的协议（如Anderson算法），需要引入介于无饥饿性与有界旁路之间的新性质。
AI.method: 1. **形式化定义**：通过修正Raynal定义，提出有界旁路=从lock第一条指令执行完毕后起计算旁路次数且上界为f(n)；提出后入口段有界旁路（忽略入口段期间旁路）和间歇有界旁路（忽略h(n)次特定写操作期间的旁路）。2. **理论证明**：对Dekker算法、Anderson算法、Bar-David算法进行精细分析；证明Bar-David算法在原子寄存器下满足有界旁路界n(n-1)-1；在安全/正规寄存器下满足间歇有界旁路界n²-2。3. **模型检测**：使用mCRL2工具，将有界旁路相关性质表达为模态μ-演算公式，对2-3进程情形进行自动验证。
AI.result: 1. 建立了完整的活性属性层次：post-doorway b.b.与intermittent b.b.均严格强于无饥饿性、严格弱于有界旁路，且两者互不蕴含。2. 证明Bar-David算法在原子寄存器下以f(n)=n(n-1)-1保证有界旁路（紧界）；在安全/正规寄存器下以f(n)=n²-2、h(n)=n保证间歇有界旁路（紧界）。3. 模型检测证实：Algorithm 3不满足安全寄存器下的有界旁路，但满足间歇有界旁路；Dekker算法满足无饥饿但不满足任何有界旁路形式；Anderson算法满足post-doorway有界旁路（f(n)=1）。4. 模型检测还帮助发现并修正了证明中非紧界和中断赋值识别不精确的问题。
AI.conclusion: 本文为互斥协议的有界旁路性质提供了严格且自洽的形式化体系，澄清了文献中长期存在的定义模糊问题；证明了任何无死锁互斥协议都可通过Bar-David算法升级为满足某种有界旁路形式；通过形式化与模型检测的结合，遵循Lamport的倡议，提高了并发算法正确性证明的可信度。研究表明在弱内存模型（安全/正规寄存器）下，需引入"间歇"放松版本才能保证有界旁路类性质。

title: Pulse: Training Acceleration for Large Diffusion Models with Automatic Pipeline Parallelism
comment: Accepted by International Conference on Distributed Computing Systems(ICDCS'26)
summary: Diffusion models are now a dominant approach for high-fidelity image and video generation, yet scaling their training across GPU clusters remains challenging. Unlike transformer-only architectures, diffusion backbones commonly adopt UNet-style encoder-decoder structures with heterogeneous layers and long-range skip connections. Under conventional pipeline parallelism, these non-local dependencies force large skip activations and their gradients to traverse multiple pipeline boundaries, making peer-to-peer (P2P) communication a dominant bottleneck and substantially reducing pipeline efficiency. In this paper, we present PULSE, an automatic pipeline-parallel training strategy that makes skip locality a first-class optimization objective. PULSE eliminates skip-induced communication by collocating skip-connected encoder-decoder layers on the same device and caching skip activations locally for later use in backpropagation. To realize this placement while maintaining high pipeline utilization, PULSE co-designs: (1) a skip-aware dynamic-programming partitioner that balances heterogeneous stage workloads under symmetric collocation constraints, (2) an ILP-based schedule synthesizer that generates bubble-efficient wave schedules for the resulting stage-to-device mapping, and (3) a hybrid parallelism tuner that selects pipeline/data-parallel degrees and microbatch sizes under memory and network constraints. Our extensive experiments show that the volume of communication can be reduced by 89 percent, and the training throughput can be increased by up to 2.3x on communication-bound hardware, compared with state-of-the-art parallelism strategies.

AI.tldr: PULSE是一种针对扩散模型的自动流水线并行训练系统，通过将跳跃连接（skip connection）的编码器-解码器层共置在同一设备上以消除跨设备通信，将通信量减少89%，在通信受限硬件上实现最高2.3倍的训练吞吐量提升。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型（如Stable Diffusion、Hunyuan-DiT）通常采用UNet风格的编码器-解码器架构，包含长程跳跃连接以保留空间细节。在传统流水线并行（如1F1B调度）下，这些非局部依赖导致跳跃激活及其梯度必须穿越多个流水线阶段边界，使得P2P通信成为主要瓶颈，通信量占比超过85%-90%，严重限制了扩散模型的可扩展性。现有自动并行框架无法处理这种由跳跃连接引入的复杂非局部数据依赖和层异构性。
AI.method: PULSE采用三项协同设计：(1) **跳跃感知动态规划划分器**——将模型分解为细粒度操作，通过双向DP算法在对称共置约束下平衡异构阶段的工作负载，将朴素的O(pn⁴)复杂度优化至O(pn³)；(2) **基于ILP的调度合成器**——将流水线调度形式化为ILP问题，定义6类约束（唯一分配、设备独占、固定设备映射、共置、顺序执行、单调微批次排序），在小规模实例上求解得到波状（wave）调度模板并推广；(3) **混合并行调优器**——在内存和网络约束下搜索最优的流水线度数P、数据并行度数G和微批次大小b，建立峰值内存和每次样本训练时间的解析模型，遍历有效配置最小化T_sample = T_sched/(b·P·G)。
AI.result: 在2节点V100集群和8节点Ascend 910A集群上评估UViT、SDv2、Hunyuan-DiT三个扩散骨干网络：(1) **通信量大幅降低**——相比Hanayo、1F1B和ZeRO-2基线，跳跃感知共置将通信量减少高达89%；(2) **吞吐量显著提升**——在Ascend 910A上比1F1B提升最高2.3×，在V100上比1F1B提升16%-125%，并在2.3×模型扩展实验中使7.2B SDv2可训练而基线发生OOM；(3) **消融研究**——动态规划划分在SDv2上带来最高85.5%吞吐量提升（层异构严重时效果显著），混合并行调优在P=4时为SDv2带来38%加速。
AI.conclusion: PULSE通过将"跳跃局部性"作为一等优化目标，弥合了扩散模型架构与分布式训练效率之间的差距。其核心贡献在于：(1) 首次将跳跃连接的共置建模为自动并行的硬约束并通过DP/ILP求解；(2) 证明波状调度是Hanayo的泛化，可自然退化为1F1B；(3) 实验验证了在通信受限硬件上可获得近线性的可扩展性增益。局限性在于当前未显式纳入张量并行（TP），且主要针对对称跳跃结构的编码器-解码器模型；未来工作将探索TP-PP组合设计空间以及非对称/部分跳跃连接模式的自动优化。

title: TurboServe: Serving Streaming Video Generation Efficiently and Economically
summary: Streaming video generation is emerging as a new serving workload in which users interact with long-lived sessions that generate video progressively, chunk by chunk. Unlike offline video generation or typical LLM serving, streaming video generation must preserve session state across active and idle periods, repeatedly schedule ongoing sessions, and deliver each chunk under a tight latency target. This creates two key serving challenges in multi-user, multi-GPU environments: session duration heterogeneity, where long-running sessions make placement decisions suboptimal over time, and temporal user-demand heterogeneity, where the number of active sessions fluctuates sharply across bursts and idle periods. We present TurboServe, the first serving system designed specifically for streaming video generation workloads. TurboServe formulates serving as an online scheduling problem that jointly coordinates session placement and GPU provisioning. Its closed-loop scheduling algorithm combines a migration-aware placement controller, which rebalances sessions across GPUs to reduce the maximum per-chunk latency, with a load-driven autoscaling controller, which adapts the GPU budget to workload variation for improved cost efficiency. To support these decisions at runtime, TurboServe implements coalesced chunk processing for batching concurrent active sessions on the same GPU, GPU-CPU offloading for session suspension and resumption, and NCCL-based GPU-GPU migration for online rebalancing. We evaluate TurboServe on real-world production traces from Shengshu Technology across multiple model sizes and GPU clusters with up to 64 NVIDIA B300 GPUs. Compared with baseline serving configurations, TurboServe reduces worst-case per-chunk latency by 37.5% and total GPU operating cost by 37.2% on average. Our code is publicly available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: TurboServe 是首个专为多用户多 GPU 环境下流式视频生成工作负载设计的服务系统。它将服务问题建模为一个在线调度问题，通过闭环调度算法联合协调会话放置（迁移感知的 min-max 重平衡控制器）和 GPU 配置（负载驱动的自动扩缩容控制器），以同时优化最差逐块延迟和 GPU 运行成本。系统支持合并块处理、GPU-CPU 状态卸载以及基于 NCCL 的 GPU-GPU 会话迁移等运行时机制。在盛视科技的真实生产 trace 和最多 64 块 NVIDIA B300 GPU 的集群上评估，TurboServe 相比基线平均降低最差逐块延迟 37.5%、降低 GPU 总运行成本 37.2%。
AI.motivation: 随着 Sora、Veo 等视频生成模型的发展，传统的离线一次性视频生成模式正被流式视频生成（如 StreamDiffusionV2、Self-Forcing、LongLive）所取代：视频以块（chunk）为单位逐步生成、接受用户实时交互信号、并必须在严格的逐块延迟目标内交付每个块。这与现有视频生成服务系统（如 FastVideo、xDiT、vLLM-Omni、TurboDiffusion、TridentServe）所针对的"无状态、一次性生成"假设形成根本冲突。在多用户多 GPU 环境下，论文识别出两个核心异质性挑战：(1) 会话时长异质性——不同会话持续时间从数秒到数十分钟不等，长时间会话的累积使初始放置决策逐渐变得次优；(2) 用户需求时间异质性——活跃会话数在突发和空闲期之间剧烈波动，静态 GPU 配置要么在高峰期欠供给、要么在低峰期过度配置。现有的 LLM 服务系统（vLLM、Sarathi-Serve、AlpaServe 等）虽考虑了动态 KV 缓存和扩缩容，但其请求是短生命周期的，而流式视频生成需在长生命周期会话的活跃/空闲状态间维持持久会话状态，并在硬性逐块延迟约束下反复调度块生成，无法直接适用。
AI.method:
TurboServe 采用闭环调度框架，核心方法包括：

1. **问题形式化**：将流式视频生成服务建模为事件驱动的在线调度问题，在每个事件（会话到达/离开/状态转换）时刻联合决定会话放置函数 φ(t) 和 GPU 预算 M(t)，优化目标为 min {C(t) + λ(t)·L(t)}，受每 GPU 容量 K 和活跃会话必被放置的双重约束。

2. **迁移感知放置控制器（Placement Controller）**：采用事件驱动的 min-max 重平衡算法。初始化时保留已有放置；为新到达和重新激活的会话选择使瓶颈延迟最小的 GPU；然后迭代执行迁移感知重平衡——从当前瓶颈 GPU 出发，评估将任一会话 s_i 迁移到目标 GPU g_j' 的收益函数 Γ = L(t) - L'(t) - η·κ_i(t)（其中 κ_i 用 α-β 模型估计迁移开销），选取最大正收益的迁移执行，直至无正收益动作。算法复杂度为 O(M(t)) 每事件，在 64 GPU 集群上调度时间 < 15 ms。

3. **负载驱动自动扩缩容控制器（Autoscaling Controller）**：基于 ρ_max(t) = max n_j(t)/K 监测最大归一化 GPU 负载。采用 (a) 滞回触发机制（hysteresis, δ=0.1）避免振荡；(b) 比例（目标跟踪）调整策略 M_tar = ⌈N_req/(K·ρ̂)⌉；(c) 基于波动率的自适应控制参数——通过滑动窗口计算会话激活的波动率 σ(t)，按离线 profile 得到的"波动率-参数映射表"动态调整 (λ(t), ρ̂(t))：高波动时用较大 λ 和较小 ρ̂ 保留更多余量，平稳时反之以提升资源效率。

4. **运行时机制**：(a) 合并块处理（coalesced chunk processing）将同 GPU 上并发活跃会话的块生成批处理以摊销模型执行开销；(b) GPU-CPU 状态卸载支持空闲会话挂起/恢复，释放 GPU 显存和执行槽位；(c) 基于 NCCL/RDMA 的 GPU-GPU 状态迁移支持在线重平衡，迁移仅移动每会话状态区域、不移动模型副本，且只在块边界执行以避免中断在飞生成步骤。

5. **扩缩容与放置的耦合**：算法 1 明确编排了 scale-in（先重平衡再移除 GPU）和 scale-out（先扩展 GPU 再重平衡）顺序，使新 GPU 被立即利用、被释放 GPU 可被安全下线。
AI.result:
**端到端性能**（LongLive-1.3B 及更大模型，H20 和 B300 集群）：
- **延迟降低**：相比 TurboServe_base、+LAG、+MAG 三种基线，TurboServe 在匹配 GPU 成本下平均降低最差逐块延迟 37.5%，最大 51.6%；如 B300 集群 1.3B 模型 Trace 1 上分别降低 28.2%、20.5%、26.6%。
- **成本降低**：在匹配延迟约束下平均降低 GPU 运行成本 37.2%，最大 49.0%；如上述配置下分别降低 38.3%、35.9%、16.7%。

**机制消融**（匹配延迟约束下 GPU 成本）：
- 去除迁移：成本增加平均 15.0%，最大 28.0%（持续负载不均衡）。
- 去除自动扩缩容：成本增加平均 42.9%，最大 80.4%（无法适应需求波动）。

**闭环调度有效性**：
- 重平衡算法相比离线穷举 oracle：质量差距平均 3.6%、最大 6.5%，调度时间降低 10× 以上。
- 自动扩缩容相比离线 oracle：成本差距平均 6.1%、最大 8.3%。
- 波动率在线映射 vs 离线 oracle：总成本差距仅 0.73%（在 30s 窗口的对比实验中），在另两条 trace 上为 2.25% 和 3.99%。

**调度开销**：4–256 GPU 集群上调度完成时间 < 0.1 s；GPU-GPU 会话迁移开销 23–30 ms（占逐块生成延迟 917–1201 ms 的 2–3%）。

**12 分钟调度快照分析**：显示自动扩缩容粗粒度调整 GPU 预算（4↔11）、迁移细粒度调整会话放置（每窗口数十次会话移动），二者协同满足工作负载不同时间尺度的需求。
AI.conclusion: TurboServe 是首个面向多用户多 GPU 环境下流式视频生成工作负载的专用服务系统，通过闭环调度框架联合优化迁移感知会话放置与负载驱动 GPU 自动扩缩容，成功应对会话时长异质性与用户需求时间异质性两大核心挑战。其合并块处理、GPU-CPU 状态卸载与基于 NCCL 的 GPU-GPU 迁移等运行时机制，使在线重平衡开销仅占逐块生成延迟的 2–3%，为生产环境中将动态扩缩容与细粒度重平衡作为常规系统控制动作提供了可行性。在盛视科技真实生产 trace 上的实验证明，TurboServe 在延迟和成本两个维度均显著优于静态放置和仅单一维度（迁移或扩缩容）的方法，且其在线控制参数机制对离线 oracle 的成本差距很小（< 8.3%），表明系统在仅依赖在线负载反馈的情况下即可获取绝大部分成本节省机会。代码已开源。

title: SCOPE-FL: A Strategy-proof Chain-based Optimal pareto efficient Federated Learning System
summary: Hierarchical Federated Learning (HFL) enables scalable collaborative model training across distributed devices while preserving data privacy. However, existing HFL client selection mechanisms suffer from a fundamental strategic inefficiency. By prioritizing stability over Pareto efficiency (PE), they produce suboptimal resource allocations, and without strategy proofness (SP), participants are incentivized to misrepresent their true preferences, both failures degrading system overall welfare in the Pareto sense in practice. To address it, we propose SCOPE-FL (Strategy-proof Chain-based Optimal pareto efficient Federated Learning), a synchronous HFL framework that formulates client selection as a two-sided school choice problem solved through the Top Trading Cycle (TTC) algorithm that simultaneously guarantees PE and SP. For reward distribution, SCOPE-FL employs a scalable Shapley value approximation based on One-Round Reconstruction (OR), ensuring compensation proportional to each client's contribution. The entire mechanism executes via blockchain smart contracts, providing the tamper-proof environment required for the SP guarantees to hold in practice. A comprehensive evaluation on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10 demonstrates that SCOPE-FL outperforms state-of-the-art approaches, including DA, IAS, and other methods across model accuracy, convergence rate, and reward efficiency, while achieving communication latency comparable to DA and blockchain overhead significantly lower than DA at scale.

AI.tldr: SCOPE-FL提出了一种基于区块链的分层联邦学习(HFL)系统，通过将客户端选择建模为双边学校选择问题并采用Top Trading Cycle (TTC)算法求解，同时保证帕累托效率(PE)和策略防伪(SP)，并结合One-Round Reconstruction (OR)Shapley值近似实现可扩展的贡献评估与公平奖励分配。
AI.motivation: 现有HFL客户端选择机制存在根本性策略低效问题：基于稳定性的机制(如DA)牺牲帕累托效率，导致资源分配次优；而缺乏策略防伪(SP)的机制(如IAS)使参与者有动机谎报偏好，两者均会降低系统整体福利。现有方法无法同时实现PE、SP和可扩展的贡献评估。
AI.method: 1) 将HFL客户端选择问题建模为双边学校选择问题(客户端↔学生，边缘服务器↔学校)；2) 使用TTC算法求解，理论上同时保证PE、SP和最小不稳定性；3) 采用基于One-Round Reconstruction (OR)的Shapley值近似方法(在每个tier-2服务器上独立执行，复杂度从O(2^|C|)降至O(|S|·2^Cap_max))评估客户端贡献；4) 通过区块链智能合约(Solidity/EVM)执行匹配和奖励机制，提供防篡改执行环境；5) 设计动态偏好更新机制(基于贡献分数、协商价格和网络延迟)使系统在每轮重新执行TTC。
AI.result: 在MNIST(95%)、Fashion-MNIST(85%)和CIFAR-10(76%)上SCOPE-FL均优于DA、IAS、MAAIM和随机选择基线方法；收敛速度更快(在MNIST上比DA节省5轮、比IAS节省9轮)；客户端平均奖励最高(69.40 vs DA的64.05)；Gas消耗显著低于DA(60×60×60规模下约98M vs DA的260M)；通信延迟与DA相当(609ms vs 588ms)。理论证明SCOPE-FL满足PE和SP。
AI.conclusion: SCOPE-FL是首个在HFL框架中同时实现帕累托效率和策略防伪的机制，通过TTC算法、OR-Shapley贡献评估和区块链智能合约的结合，解决了客户端选择中的策略低效问题。实验验证其在模型精度、收敛速度、奖励效率和区块链开销方面均优于现有方法。未来工作包括探索扁平多服务器架构以及采用FedProx处理更强烈的非IID数据分布。

title: Beyond Prediction: Tail-Aware Scheduling for LLM Inference
summary: LLM serving exhibits extreme length variability, making size-based scheduling difficult in practice. Recent LLM schedulers approximate SJF/SRPT using predicted decode lengths or ranks and primarily report mean-centric metrics such as TTFT and TBT. We show that these prediction-driven policies can be fragile under distribution shifts, bursty arrivals, and GPU memory pressure, while offering limited control over the tail latency (P90-P99) that dominates user experience, even with perfect decode-length knowledge. We introduce a distribution-aware, prediction-free scheduling framework that replaces explicit length prediction with soft priority boosting driven by lightweight statistical signals. Our design co-optimizes scheduling and cache-aware preemption to account for memory-coupled decode dynamics across workload mixes. Evaluated on production and open-source traces, our method reduces P99 TTLT by up to 35-50% relative to SRPT with perfect length knowledge and reduces TTFT by 34-47% across workloads, including reasoning-heavy and chat-heavy tasks. These results demonstrate a robust alternative for optimizing tail latency in online LLM serving.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于LLM推理服务的"无预测、分布感知"的调度框架，通过轻量级统计信号驱动的软优先级提升替代显式长度预测，并结合缓存感知的抢占机制，在生产级和开源trace上实现P99 TTLT相对SRPT(完美长度知识)降低35-50%、TTFT降低34-47%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM调度器多采用SJF/SRPT近似策略，依赖预测的解码长度或排序来缩短平均延迟（TTFT/TBT）。然而作者指出：(1) 基于预测的策略在分布漂移、突发流量、GPU内存压力下表现脆弱；(2) 即使拥有完美的解码长度知识，对P90-P99尾延迟的控制仍然有限，而这恰恰是影响用户体验的关键。因此需要一种不依赖精确长度预测、且能稳定优化尾延迟的调度机制。
AI.method: 提出"分布感知、无预测"的调度框架，核心包含两个设计：(1) 用轻量级统计信号驱动的"软优先级提升(soft priority boosting)"替代显式长度预测，避免预测误差带来的脆弱性；(2) 将调度与缓存感知抢占(cache-aware preemption)进行联合优化，以应对不同工作负载混合下由KV cache耦合引起的解码动态变化。整体设计强调通过概率分布层面的先验而非点估计来进行调度决策。
AI.result: 在生产级和开源trace上的评估显示：相对SRPT（配备完美长度知识），P99 TTLT降低35-50%；跨多种工作负载（含推理密集型和聊天密集型任务）TTFT降低34-47%。结果表明该方法在缺乏精确长度预测时仍能稳健优化尾延迟，对分布漂移和突发到达具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明：在LLM在线推理服务中，去除对显式长度预测的依赖、采用分布感知与软优先级调度的方案，是优化尾延迟（特别是P99 TTLT）和TTFT的稳健替代方案，为后续面向用户体验的LLM调度器设计提供了新方向。

title: Exploring Statistical Change Point Detection Techniques for Performance Anomaly Detection at Mozilla
summary: Software performance regressions can have significant business consequences, making automated detection a critical component of modern continuous integration pipelines. At Mozilla, performance anomaly detection is handled by Perfherder, Mozilla's performance engineering management system that relies on a Student's T-test-based approach to flag regressions across hundreds of daily code changes. However, our preliminary analysis of one year of Mozilla performance data reveals that 12.5% of generated alert groups are false positives, while approximately 6.8% of them contain regressions missed by the automated system. This paper presents an empirical study evaluating 25 change-point detection (CPD) methods and 15 ensemble approaches as alternatives to Mozilla's current method. We construct a ground-truth dataset of 174 performance time series manually annotated by eleven Mozilla performance engineers, representing one of the first practitioner-annotated CPD benchmarks for performance engineering. Our results show that while offline and hybrid CPD methods improve recall over Mozilla's method, they do so at a high cost to precision. Ensemble voting strategies alleviate this trade-off and offer more consistent performance, resulting in 11% improvement in the F1-score. We validate the experimental results through a practitioner survey and report on lessons learned from integrating the best methods into Mozilla's performance engineering system.

AI.tldr: 本文针对 Mozilla 性能工程管理系统 Perfherder 中基于 Student T 检验的性能异常检测方法存在的高误报率（12.5%）和漏报率（6.8%）问题，系统评估了 25 种变更点检测（CPD）方法和 15 种集成投票策略。研究构建了一个由 11 位 Mozilla 性能工程师手工标注的 174 条性能时间序列基准数据集，扩展了 TCPDBench 工具集，并结合工程师问卷调查进行实践验证，最终证明集成投票策略（特别是 F1-score 达到 78.4% 的离线集成方法）能显著优于 Mozilla 当前方法，且更易获得工程师部署认可。
AI.motivation: 软件性能回归会对业务产生重大影响，自动检测是 CI/CD 流水线的关键环节。Mozilla 当前的 Perfherder 系统使用基于 Student T 检验的方法，但初步分析显示其存在 12.5% 的误报和 6.8% 的漏报，且 T 检验对性能数据的正态性和方差齐性假设往往不成立。此外，低人工告警创建率可能掩盖真实的漏报问题，因为工程师对自动化系统的高信任度会降低人工报告偏差的频率。这些问题促使研究者系统性地探索替代性的统计变更点检测方法。
AI.method: 研究采用设计科学（Design Science）的"问题-解决方案"范式，包含三个核心环节：（1）对 Mozilla 一年性能数据进行初步分析，量化误报与漏报规模；（2）构建实践者标注的基准数据集——从 5655 条时间序列中筛选 Speedometer3 和 TP6 子集的 400 条样本，由 11 位 Mozilla 性能工程师（平均 13.2 年工程经验）在 AnnotationChange 平台上完成标注，最终获得 174 条由多人标注的时间序列，平均 OvR F1 达 0.76；（3）基于 TCPDBench 扩展集成 25 种 CPD 方法（9 种离线、9 种在线、5 种混合以及基线方法），加上 15 种集成投票策略（共识阈值 C=1~6，容差 M=5），采用多标注者评估框架（precision、recall、F1），并在三种配置（默认、最佳、上界）下进行评估；（4）通过 12 位 Mozilla 工程师参与的研讨会和问卷调查，对研究假设（M=5 容差、F1 等权重）和推荐方法进行工业验证。
AI.result: 主要结果包括：（1）离线 CPD 方法方面，MongoDB（E-Divisive）在默认配置下以 73.4% F1 超越 Mozilla 方法（70.6%）；调优后 CPNP、KCPA、MongoDB 分别达到 72.4%、72.8%、74.0%；上界性能下 KCPA 达到 83.5%。（2）在线方法普遍较差，仅 BOCPD 在上界性能下接近 Mozilla 方法（79.9%），EWMA 因超参数敏感性表现为离群点。（3）混合方法默认配置下召回率高（>90%）但精度低（<35%），调优后仍难超越基线。（4）集成投票效果最佳：离线集成（C=3）F1 达 78.4%（精度 86.4%，召回率 75.3%），Mozilla 或混合集成（C=3）F1 达 77.2%，相比 Mozilla 方法提升 7-8 个百分点。（5）实践者调查：11/12 工程师强烈认可应优先减少漏报；零位工程师认可任何独立 CPD 方法可部署；7 人选择集成投票、5 人选择"Mozilla 或集成"策略作为部署候选。（6）部署经验：采用 M=1 容差、排除不稳定的 Levene 方法、修复 p 值为零时的相邻重复告警问题。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，传统单一统计方法难以同时满足生产环境中精度和召回率的双重要求。集成投票策略（特别是将 Mozilla 高精度基线与混合方法投票结合的方案）通过聚合多个方法的互补优势，可在维持较高精度的同时显著提升召回率，F1-score 达到 78.4%，且获得实践者的高度认可和部署意愿。该研究还贡献了：（1）首个大规模实践者标注的 CPD 性能工程基准数据集（174 条时间序列）；（2）扩展的 TCPDBench 工具集（含 15 种新增 CPD 方法）；（3）经过工业验证的部署指导方案。对实践者的启示包括：应将精度-召回权衡作为明确的组织策略而非依赖默认参数；不应将低人工告警率误判为系统表现良好；集成投票应被视为升级现有 CPD 流水线的主要候选方案而非实验性扩展。

title: Finding Compiler-Platform Interaction Bugs in Deep Learning Pipelines via Cross-Layer Constraints
summary: The growing deployment of artificial intelligence (AI) necessitates robust deep learning (DL) compilers, such as TVM and ONNX-MLIR. These compilers take as input high-level AI models, lower them through multi-layer transformations, and specialize them to diverse hardware. Testing such compilers is uniquely challenging as correctness depends on implicit constraints embedded throughout the compilation stack. Existing testing approaches largely take type constraints to restrict input model generation and therefore emphasize type validation and monitor compilation crashes or coverage gains. This focus overlooks compiler-platform interaction bugs that arise from interleaved effects across compilation and execution environments. In this work, we propose a scalable, automated DL compiler testing framework for, in tandem, (1) finding compiler-platform interaction bugs and (2) enabling behavior equivalence partitioning. Our key insight is that these bugs are caused by violated assumptions arising from interactions across compilation passes and hardware platforms. Therefore, we move beyond constraining input generation and derive full-stack constraints. Our approach is three-fold. First, we design an automated approach to extract full-stack constraints that jointly guide model generation and characterize compilation behaviors. Second, we prioritize constraints that expose interaction-sensitive behaviors, so our generated models are capable of exercising deep compilation logic. Third, we enable behavior equivalence partitioning by automatically inserting assertions to monitor distinct compilation symptoms that coverage or pass/fail signals miss. We evaluated our tool, XCheck, on three widely-used DL compilers and found 2,034 bug-revealing cases, including memory overflows, integer overflows, and silent unexpected compilations that were rooted in compiler-platform interactions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 XCheck 框架，针对深度学习编译器（TVM、ONNX-MLIR 等）测试中的编译器-平台交互缺陷，提出基于"全栈约束"（full-stack constraints）的自动化测试方法，通过约束提取、优先级排序与行为等价划分三大机制，在三种主流 DL 编译器中发现 2,034 个缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有 DL 编译器测试方法主要依赖类型约束来限制输入模型生成，侧重类型验证与编译崩溃/覆盖率监测，忽视了跨编译环境与执行环境交织产生的编译器-平台交互缺陷（compiler-platform interaction bugs），导致测试覆盖不足、漏检隐式约束违反类问题。
AI.method: 方法包含三个核心部分：(1) 自动化提取全栈约束——联合指导模型生成并刻画编译行为；(2) 优先级排序——聚焦暴露交互敏感行为的约束，使生成模型能深入执行编译逻辑；(3) 行为等价划分——自动插入断言，监测覆盖率与通过/失败信号无法捕捉的编译症状差异。
AI.result: 在三种广泛使用的 DL 编译器上进行评估，XCheck 共发现 2,034 个缺陷揭示用例（bug-revealing cases），涵盖内存溢出、整数溢出以及由编译器-平台交互引发的静默非预期编译等错误类型。
AI.conclusion: XCheck 通过超越单纯的输入类型约束，从全栈视角提取并利用编译层级与硬件平台间的隐式约束假设，显著提升 DL 编译器交互缺陷的检测能力，为 DL 编译器测试提供了可扩展、自动化的新范式。

title: A Critical Discourse Analysis of Gender Representation in Software Engineering Education Videos on YouTube
summary: Educational resources may frame students' perceptions of who belongs in software engineering, which is relevant given the field's ongoing gender gap. However, we know little about the hidden curriculum regarding gender in online learning spaces. This study presents a critical discourse analysis of 200 manually analysed English and German software engineering tutorials on YouTube, examining gender representation through contextual domains and linguistic identity markers. Our results show that male characters and masculine linguistic defaults dominate the tutorials. We identified an agency gap, in which technical and decision-making roles are almost exclusively assigned to male actors, while female actors are either absent or tend to passive, low-agency roles. The findings indicate that software engineering education on YouTube may reproduce gendered norms, in which linguistic and representational gatekeeping may serve as a symbolic barrier to software engineering.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过对200个YouTube上的英语和德语软件工程教学视频进行批判性话语分析(CDA),发现男性角色和男性化语言默认值在教程中占主导地位,存在显著的"能动性差距"——技术性和决策性角色几乎完全由男性担任,而女性角色要么缺失,要么处于被动的低能动性角色。研究表明YouTube软件工程教育可能在再现性别化规范,语言和表征的把控可能成为女性进入软件工程领域的象征性障碍。
AI.motivation: 软件工程领域存在持续的性别差距,教育资源的呈现方式会影响学习者对"谁属于该领域"的认知。尽管已有研究关注教科书中的性别表征,但对在线学习空间(如YouTube)中软件工程教程的隐性课程(hidden curriculum)知之甚少。此外,德语的"通用阳性"(generic masculine)等跨语言语法结构可能加剧这种隐性偏见。该研究旨在填补这一研究空白,揭示在线技术教育中潜在的性别排斥机制。
AI.method: 采用批判性话语分析(CDA)框架,结合Mayring的定性内容分析法:1)数据收集:使用Python脚本和YouTube Data API构建包含1,225个视频的数据集(英语702、德语178、意大利语345);2)分层抽样:为确保手工编码可行性,选取100个英语和100个德语视频(共200个,超过94小时内容);3)分析框架:包含四个维度——情境领域(商业、技术、社会娱乐、公共教育)、身份标记(命名、角色引用、通用默认)、能动性(高/低)、偏见指标;4)编码过程:两位研究者独立编码10个视频,Cohen's κ=0.87,几乎完全一致;5)采用加权计数法分析性别组合,引入性别表征指数(-1到3分)。
AI.result: 研究发现:1)男性角色在软件工程教育中占绝对主导;2)存在"能动性差距":技术性和决策性角色几乎完全分配给男性,女性要么缺失,要么担任被动的低能动性角色(如用户、消费者);3)德语样本中阳性代词与男性命名角色高度相关,表明"通用阳性"已内化为创作者的心智模型,而非真正的语言中性;4)英语表面看似中性,但深层仍延续男性主导的技术权威模式;5)仅有一例由黑人女性创作者制作的视频展示了无男性参与的高能动性技术角色,体现了典型的"象征性代表"(tokenism)问题;6)在涉及人类示例时,话语会自动回归"男性掌权"的模式,即使在敏捷教学等中性主题中,领导者也通常被默认为男性。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了软件工程在线教育中性别表征的首个实证证据,表明尽管英语在语言层面趋于中性,但两种语言都难以在情境上下文中充分代表女性,尤其是在高能动性技术角色方面。教程通过隐性课程强化了"软件工程是男性领域"的信号,可能加剧非男性学习者的"非归属感"。建议创作者使用多样化命名、性别中性代词和平衡的角色分配,推动在线软件工程教育更具包容性。未来研究方向包括:扩展到法语等罗曼语族及性别中立语言、纳入非二元性别视角、探究种族与残疾的交叉性、以及通过实验验证性别中性教程对学生自我效能的影响。

title: Designing L5: A Permacomputing Approach to Creative Coding
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, In LIMITS 26: Workshop on Computing within Limits, June 23 - 25, 2026
summary: Creative coding libraries provide high-level tools that make computational and algorithmic art accessible to artists and learners. Processing/p5 is one such family of libraries, known for its beginner-friendly approach and wide reach across artistic and technical communities. L5 is a new member of this family, implemented in Lua using the LOVE framework. It applies permacomputing principles, a movement addressing sustainability in computing inspired by permaculture, bringing these values to a community of practice not historically centered on them. This paper explores L5's design decisions and tensions between sustainability and usability through five case studies: 1. balancing perceived simplicity versus exposing the seams, 2. designing for lower resource consumption, 3. ensuring long-term stability, 4. constraining functionality, and 5. designing documentation for resource-constrained access. Rather than optimizing for a single metric, sustainable creative tools require navigating competing values transparently.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种名为 L5 的新型创意编程库，基于 Lua 和 LOVE 框架实现，旨在将"永续计算"（permacomputing）原则融入创意编码工具设计中。通过五个案例研究，探讨了可持续性与可用性之间的设计权衡。
AI.motivation: 传统创意编程库（如 Processing/p5）虽易于上手，但往往未考虑可持续性问题。永续计算运动倡导借鉴永续农业理念解决计算领域的可持续性挑战。论文动机在于将永续计算理念引入历来不关注该议题的创意编程社区，填补这一空白。
AI.method: 采用案例研究方法，通过 L5 库的设计实践，从五个维度分析设计决策中的张力：1）表观简洁性与暴露底层机制之间的平衡；2）低资源消耗设计；3）长期稳定性保障；4）功能约束；5）面向资源受限访问的文档设计。通过具体设计决策展示如何处理相互竞争的价值观。
AI.result: 研究发现可持续创意工具不能仅优化单一指标，而需要在相互竞争的价值之间进行透明的权衡。五个案例展示了在简洁性、透明性、资源效率、稳定性、功能范围和文档可达性等方面的具体设计取舍，强调透明化的价值取舍过程本身是可持续设计的重要组成部分。
AI.conclusion: L5 作为永续计算理念在创意编程领域的一次实践，证明永续性不仅是技术问题，更是设计哲学问题。可持续创意工具的开发需要在多个相互竞争的价值（如简洁性与透明性、功能丰富与资源节约、现代特性与长期稳定）之间审慎导航，并通过透明的设计决策过程让用户理解这些权衡。

title: Toward Semantically-Seeded, Graph-Propagated Impact Analysis Across Software Artifacts: A Vision
summary: When a single software artifact changes - a requirement, a configuration value, or a function - engineers must determine what else is impacted. Existing change-impact-analysis (CIA) tooling tends to rely on one of two signals in isolation: semantic similarity recovered from text (information-retrieval traceability, code search, embeddings), or structural dependency following (call graphs, IDE "find usages", test-impact selection). Each has a characteristic blind spot. A semantically driven tool misses an impacted artifact whose text shares no vocabulary with the change; a structurally driven tool misses artifacts related in meaning but not joined by an edge, and most operate only over code rather than the Requirement-Config-Service-Test chain. We argue for a training-free and interpretable analyzer that fuses both signals over the same embeddings. We model the system as a heterogeneous artifact graph with typed edges recovered by static analysis, compute a semantic prior by cosine similarity to the changed artifact, propagate impact multi-hop with decay over a row-normalized propagation matrix, and blend the two with a single tunable weight lambda. A small but complete proof-of-concept on a payment subsystem (5 labelled change scenarios) shows the mechanism we care about: artifacts with zero textual overlap with the change are still recovered through propagation, and helper functions that propagation alone cannot reach are recovered through the semantic layer. The fusion is the only configuration that covers both blind spots, and lambda acts as an explicit precision/recall control. Drawing on four publicly documented production failures, we argue that the same formulation extends to operational artifacts (images, metrics, dashboards, data schemas) that code-only analysis cannot reach.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇愿景论文,提出了一种训练无关、可解释的变更影响分析(CIA)方法。该方法通过单一可调权重λ,将语义相似度(基于文本嵌入的余弦相似度)与结构依赖传播(在行归一化传播矩阵上的多跳衰减传播)在同一嵌入空间中融合,以恢复异构制品图(需求-配置-服务-测试,以及运维制品如镜像、指标、告警、数据)中两类单独信号都无法捕获的受影响制品。
AI.motivation: 现有CIA工具通常单独依赖两类信号中的一种:(1)基于文本的语义相似性(信息检索、嵌入检索)——存在语义盲点,即无法发现与变更无词汇重叠的受影响制品;(2)结构依赖追踪(调用图、IDE查找用法、测试影响选择)——存在结构盲点,即无法发现意义相关但无依赖边相连的制品,且绝大多数仅作用于源代码而非完整的"需求→配置→服务→测试"链路。论文以四个公开的生产事故(Datadog容器基础镜像更新、RevenueCat数据库引擎升级、Cloudflare指标重命名、遗留共享数据耦合)说明纯结构、仅限代码的分析器会将被影响的制品评分归零,因为不存在可追踪的边。
AI.method:
1. **异构制品图建模**:节点类型包括R(需求)、C(配置)、S(服务/函数)、T(测试),通过Python AST静态分析自动恢复四种类型化边(R→C、C→S、S→S、T→S)。可扩展到运维制品类型:Image(容器镜像)、Metric(指标)、Alert/Dashboard(告警/仪表板)、Data(数据模式)。
2. **第一层——语义先验**:将每个制品的文本嵌入后,计算所有制品与变更制品的余弦相似度,得到向量s∈[0,1]ⁿ;支持TF-IDF(离线)和Sentence-BERT(all-MiniLM-L6-v2)两种可互换后端。
3. **第二层——结构传播**:对类型化边取反方向(影响流向依赖方),构建行归一化传播矩阵M;采用Katz中心性/个性化PageRank风格的多跳几何衰减传播公式p=∑γᵏ(e_c Mᵏ),γ为逐跳衰减率,K为传播跳数,归一化至[0,1]。
4. **融合**:impact = λ·s + (1-λ)·p;λ=1为纯语义基线,λ=0为纯结构分析,中间值为混合。每个被标记的制品都附带显式传播路径,具备可解释性。
5. **运维制品边抽取**:Image→Service来自Dockerfile/K8s/Compose/Helm清单;Service→Metric来自监控客户端API调用的字符串字面量;Metric→Alert/Dashboard来自Prometheus/Grafana表达式中的指标名;Service→Data及Data↔Data来自SQL/ORM或共享键惯例/历史耦合/语义先验。
AI.result:
在支付子系统的概念验证实验中(13个制品、14条类型化边、5个标注的变更场景,TF-IDF先验,τ=0),宏平均结果如下:
- 仅语义(λ=1.0):P=0.417, R=0.873, F1=0.529(高召回、低精度,典型IR失败模式)
- 提议融合(λ=0.5):P=0.450, R=1.000, F1=0.589(达到完美召回)
- 仅结构(λ=0.0):P=0.927, R=0.786, F1=0.849(在此小型依赖密集型图上F1最高)

关键发现:(1)语义层过预测;(2)融合达完美召回,λ与τ为显式的精度/召回控制;(3)零文本相似度的制品(如R1变更下的test_complete_order)通过传播恢复——直接验证核心假设;(4)被调用方辅助函数(loadConfig、_callGateway)无法仅通过传播到达,由语义层恢复——因此只有融合配置同时覆盖两个盲点。论文明确指出此合成图上结构单独表现最佳是人为结果,贡献在于机制层面的覆盖率,而非总体精度。
AI.conclusion: 论文定位了一种在融合架构设计空间中尚未充分占据的特定点:训练无关、可解释(为每个被标记制品输出显式传播路径)、覆盖异构非源代码制品的融合方案。与GNN(需训练数据、黑盒)和GraphRAG(昂贵非确定性LLM调用)相比,该方法以固定类型化传播换取确定性、零训练成本和可验证路径,适合审计、追溯和安全关键场景。论文将这些数字定位为机制说明而非泛化证据,并提出研究议程:(1)基于历史协同变更或GNN的可学习传播;(2)以传播候选为精确检索的LLM验证层;(3)运行时追踪与历史共变信号;(4)跨语言、跨服务、跨运维制品的图扩展并重建上述公开事故;(5)每制品/每变更类型自适应λ与τ;(6)开发者标注的真实项目基准。结论是:只有λ融合配置能同时覆盖两个盲点,在保持确定性与可解释性的同时达到完整召回;方法可扩展到镜像、指标、仪表板、数据模式等代码分析无法触及的运维制品。

title: Written by AI, Managed by AI: Semantic Space Control and Index Sickness Elimination Across 391 Consecutive Sessions
comment: 22 pages, 2 tables, 1 figure. Action research. Bilingual submission (Chinese companion version included as supplementary). Submitted to ICSE 2027 IOR track
summary: The prevailing engineering intuition for addressing conceptual drift in long-horizon LLM collaboration is to trade more formal constraints for more reliable outputs -- designing symbolic identifier systems, accumulating defensive rules in System Prompts, expanding context windows. Our engineering record shows that in long-horizon settings, this direction may produce effects contrary to design intent. Using action research methods in a real software project (Bang-v3) spanning approximately one month and 391 collaborative sessions, we document and analyze the failure process of these strategies. When the symbolic system exceeds a complexity threshold, LLMs do not become more accurate -- instead, they abandon genuine understanding of business semantics, retreat to self-referential reasoning within the symbolic layer, and generate outputs that appear internally consistent but are physically disconnected from reality. We name this failure pattern "Index Sickness," and its canonical manifestation "Phantom Legislation." We name the underlying principle the "Pang Principle (Semantic Vitality Law)": natural language carrying explicit purpose conveys far greater information quality than symbolic expression. From this, we design and validate its physical engineering mechanism: "Baseline-Log Physical Separation." In the same project, this mechanism reduced AI Instructions volume by ~75%, and across the subsequent ~150 sessions, no recurrence of Index Sickness was observed. A bilingual companion version (Chinese) is included as supplementary material.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"索引病"（Index Sickness）这一LLM长程协作失效模式，揭示过度符号化约束反而导致模型脱离业务语义；据此提出"语义活力定律"（Pang Principle）及"基线-日志物理分离"工程机制，在真实项目中将AI指令量减少约75%并消除该故障复发。
AI.motivation: 主流工程直觉认为在LLM长程协作中应对"概念漂移"应施加更多形式化约束（符号标识符、系统提示防御规则、扩展上下文窗口）。然而作者在真实项目中观察到该路径产生与设计意图相反的效果：当符号系统超过复杂度阈值后，模型并非更准确，而是放弃对业务语义的真正理解，退守至符号层自指推理，输出表面自洽但与现实脱节的结果（即"幻影立法"）。研究动机在于揭示并命名这一未被识别的失效模式，并给出可工程落地的反制机制。
AI.method: 采用行动研究法（action research），依托真实软件项目 Bang-v3（历时约一个月、391次协作会话），对"加重符号/规则约束"策略的失败过程进行记录与归因分析。在此基础上提炼出"索引病"失效模式与"语义活力定律"（即显式带目的的自然语言的信息质量远高于符号表达），并据此设计工程机制"基线-日志物理分离"（Baseline-Log Physical Separation），在同项目后续约150次会话中进行验证。
AI.result: 1) 命名并刻画失效模式"索引病"及其典型表征"幻影立法"：模型在超复杂符号系统中产生内部一致但脱离业务现实的输出；2) 提出"语义活力定律"作为解释性原则；3) 设计的"基线-日志物理分离"机制在 Bang-v3 中将 AI 指令体量削减约75%，且在后续约150次会话中未再观察到索引病复发，表明该机制在长程协作中具备可复现的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 在LLM长程协作中，形式化约束并非单调有益；当符号系统复杂度过高时，模型会丧失语义理解、产生"幻影立法"式失效。因此应以"语义活力优先"取代"约束堆叠"思路，通过"基线-日志物理分离"等保持自然语言业务语义的工程机制来抑制概念漂移。该工作同时呼吁研究者关注LLM在长程、复杂工程语境下的认知退化模式，而非仅追求更强的形式化能力。

title: Teaching Software Engineering with LLM and MCP Integration: From Classroom to Industry Practice
comment: Aceept by International Symposium on Educational Technology (ISET) 2026
summary: The rapid integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) into industrial software engineering has created a pressing need to update software engineering education to align with emerging technologies and evolving industry demands. This study investigates an innovative approach that integrates LLMs and MCP into a collaborative teaching model for software engineering education, aiming to build a practical learning framework closely connected to real-world engineering practices. By embedding LLM and MCP driven tools into daily teaching, code assistance, and engineering simulations, the model effectively bridges the gap between traditional instruction and industrial workflows. This integration enhances students' programming competence, practical problem-solving abilities, and proficiency in using intelligent engineering tools. Furthermore, through partnerships with industry internships, students can apply these technologies in real-world settings, further strengthening the connection between academic preparation and professional practice. Overall, this research offers a practical pathway for reforming and innovating software engineering education in the era of artificial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将大语言模型（LLM）和模型上下文协议（MCP）融入软件工程教育的创新协同教学模式，构建了一个为期16周的渐进式教学框架，包含理论教学和工业实践两大模块，通过混合评估体系（70%定量+30%定性）衡量学生的AI协同工程能力，旨在弥合高校教育与工业实践之间的鸿沟。
AI.motivation: LLM和MCP在工业软件开发中迅速普及，但当前软件工程教育仍聚焦传统编程和软件生命周期理论，缺乏对MCP等标准化AI协同开发协议的体系化训练，导致学生与工业AI工程岗位需求严重脱节，亟需教育范式改革。
AI.method: 1. 提出"MCP核心、LLM辅助"的教学原则；2. 设计16周渐进式双模块教学路径（基础理论模块1-8周：SE知识、LLM基础、MCP三架构；实践模块9-16周：MCP适配开发、LLM-MCP协同开发、企业真实项目）；3. 融合课堂演示、工业案例教学、企业工程师联合指导等多场景教学方式；4. 构建70%定量+30%定性的混合评估体系，覆盖理论知识、实践操作、MCP适配、项目质量及学习主动性、创新能力、工业协作表现等多维指标。
AI.result: 构建了一套完整的LLM-MCP协同教学系统，包含理论框架、多元教学方法、多维评估标准和企业联动机制；明确了MCP在智能软件开发中的实践价值；提出三大培养目标（MCP框架适配优化能力、标准化LLM-MCP协同开发能力、工业岗位适应能力）。但研究存在一定局限性：未针对不同层次高校和不同专业进行个性化适配、教学资源主要围绕主流技术版本、企业联动机制尚未形成可复制推广的标准化模式。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的LLM-MCP协同实践教学路径为AI时代软件工程教育改革提供了可行方案，通过理论与实践结合、校企合作，有效桥接学术培养与职业需求。未来工作将持续追踪LLM和MCP技术更新，优化教学资源和机制，推动该教学范式的大规模应用，并探索分层教学、全生命周期能力评估、智能教学辅助工具等五个核心研究方向。

title: No Two Developers Think Alike: How Problem-Solving Styles and Experience Shape Needs in Conversational Interaction with Copilot
comment: Accepted at the International Conference on Software Maintenance and Evolution (ICSME), 2026
summary: Conversational LLM-based ``programming assistants'' provide a range of benefits to developers. However, recent studies demonstrate the variety in individual developers' needs regarding programming assistants, and challenges encountered by only specific groups of developers. In this study, we explore the role of cognitive diversity in shaping interactions with GitHub Copilot chat. Through a mixed-methods think aloud study with 27 professional developers and students, we characterize 5 distinct ``interaction modes'' and 10 underlying needs in developers' interactions, forming a conceptual model. We characterize links between these modes, needs, and developers' problem-solving styles and experience profiles, showing how cognitive diversity may shape developers' interactions. We provide insights and recommendations for researchers and practitioners on how to design, research, and employ programming assistants to better account for diverse developer needs.

AI.tldr: 本文通过混合方法的出声思考研究（27名专业开发者与学生），探究认知多样性（问题解决风格与经验）如何塑造开发者与GitHub Copilot Chat的对话交互。作者识别出5种交互模式、10项底层需求，并构建了一个将交互模式、需求与认知多样性联系起来的概念模型。
AI.motivation: LLM编程助手在SE任务中表现强劲，但已有研究表明其在认知多样性方面支持不足（如经验、性别、问题解决风格等方面存在差距），且不同开发者群体面临不同挑战。然而，认知多样性如何塑造开发者与编程助手的具体交互需求尚不清楚。解决此问题对于提升编程助手的包容性至关重要。
AI.method: 采用混合方法的出声思考研究（think aloud study），结合回溯性访谈。27名参与者（18名专业人士+9名学生）在GitHub Codespaces中使用GitHub Copilot Chat完成基于TodoMVC React项目的6个渐进难度的代码变更任务。方法包括：（1）前测问卷收集经验档案与基于GenderMag框架的问题解决风格；（2）出声思考+屏幕音频录制；（3）后测问卷（TAM、NASA-TLX）；（4）使用LDA与NMF主题建模识别交互模式；（5）基于扎根理论的开轴编码识别需求；（6）使用CLR变换与Spearman相关分析连接交互模式与认知特征。
AI.result: 识别出5种交互模式：Navigator（导航定位代码）、Autopilot（一键式全自动解决）、Deputy（增量协作式）、Technician（细粒度代码生成）、Scholar（代码解释/信息支持）。识别出10项核心需求：能力（Ability）、自主性（Agency）、实验性（Experimentation）、保障（Assurance）、生产力（Productivity）、便利性（Ease）、学习（Learning）、理解（Understanding）、委派（Delegation）、控制（Control）。关键相关发现：编程与领域经验越高，越倾向Technician模式而越少Navigator/Autopilot/Deputy；风险容忍度与Autopilot呈（反直觉的）负相关；Scholar模式与高感知努力显著强相关；Autopilot与较低心理负荷相关。需求间存在复杂增强或竞争关系（如委派与控制之间的权衡）。
AI.conclusion: 构建的概念模型揭示了开发者与Copilot交互中需求、交互模式与认知/情境因素之间的复杂联系，强调不存在"一刀切"的设计方案。研究建议：（1）研究者应将竞争性需求与认知多样性纳入影响、设计和质量研究中；（2）工具构建者应为不同交互模式提供细粒度支持；（3）组织应关注员工在编程助手使用上的个体差异。研究指出了未来方向，包括考察其他交互类型（超越对话）、SDLC其他阶段（计划与设计）以及交互模式间的时序动态。

title: Runtime Compliance Verification for AI Agents
summary: AI agents now handle personal data through tool use, function calls, and multi turn dialogue, which can create obligations under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Current testing practices mainly rely on offline red teaming or static prompt review, but they do not guarantee at runtime that agent behavior follows regulatory rules. We propose C-Trace (Compliance Trace based Runtime Agent Conformance Enforcement), a verification framework that: (i) expresses a subset of GDPR requirements, including consent, purpose limitation, data minimization, and the right to erasure, as formal policy predicates over agent execution traces; (ii) uses a runtime monitor that intercepts every tool invocation and model output and rejects non-compliant actions; and (iii) tests the agent with attack dialogues, including DSPy generated prompts and verbatim prompts from red teaming corpora, that try to induce violations. We evaluate the framework on four case studies reframed to GDPR. Under 10 percent per-category extractor noise, including drop-out and over-typing, the monitor keeps the attack success rate at less than or equal to 12 percent, below the baselines we compare against, and false positives at less than or equal to 16 percent, and reaches 0 percent ASR under perfect extraction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 C-Trace 框架,首次将 GDPR 合规性作为运行时验证问题,通过形式化策略谓词拦截 AI 代理的工具调用,实时阻断违规行为。在四个案例研究中,精确提取下将攻击成功率(ASR)和误报率(FPR)均降至 0%;在 10% 类别提取噪声下,ASR 保持在 ≤12%,FPR ≤16%,优于无监控基线和无状态护栏。
AI.motivation: AI 代理通过工具调用和自然语言对话处理个人数据,产生 GDPR 合规义务。现有测试方法(离线红队测试、静态提示审查、无状态护栏)无法保证运行时合规性,因为合规性是依赖会话历史的轨迹属性(如是否先前已同意、是否已发出删除请求),而非单条消息的属性。无状态护栏无法追踪这些跨事件条件。
AI.method: 核心方法包含三部分:(1) 类型化事件模型——将代理执行抽象为 UserMsg、AsstMsg、ToolCall、ToolRet、Consent、Erasure 六类事件序列,每个事件标注数据类别 C(e) 和目的集 Π(e);(2) 四个一阶谓词 P₁–P₄ 分别编码 GDPR 四项原则(同意、目的限制、数据最小化、删除权),单调地随轨迹前缀增量求值,违规即在当前前缀出现时立即报告;(3) 运行时拦截器置于代理循环与 API 之间,决策为 forward/redact/block,同时维护 accepted 轨迹和含所有事件的 audit 轨迹。同一条策略以 Python、Rego/OPA、MFOTL/MonPoly 三种运行时实现并交叉验证一致。攻击驱动使用 DSPy 生成提示加 HarmBench/AdvBench/DAN 逐字提示,由独立可观察预言机(而非谓词本身)判定攻击是否成功。
AI.result: 在 Shopper、Airline、MedAgent、FinAssist 四个案例研究(共 4×2×50=400 条攻击对话)中:精确提取下 C-Trace 的 ASR 和 FPR 均为 0%,优于 None(部分家族 ASR 达 100%)、Regex(MedAgent/FinAssist 上 FPR 高达 100%)和 Presidio(无法阻止依赖会话状态的 A₁/A₂/A₄ 攻击);10% 类别提取噪声下 ASR ≤12%,FPR ≤16%;消融实验证实每个谓词对各自家族不可或缺(移除 P₃ 后 A₃ 恢复至 41–90%);每事件谓词评估中位延迟仅 1.8μs,相对 LLM 调用可忽略;独立 GDPR 文章法官在 251 个已实现违规上与结构化预言机一致率达 88%(删除权 100%,数据最小化 99%)。
AI.conclusion: C-Trace 证明了会话感知、轨迹级的监控是 AI 代理 GDPR 合规的可行执行层,形式化谓词 + 运行时拦截 + 独立预言机的设计分离了策略、机制和评估。该方法可扩展到类似法规(LGPD、CPRA、PIPEDA),但可靠性主要受类别提取器质量制约;未来工作应加强领域自适应提取器并验证在并发会话、更大策略库和更长轨迹下的可扩展性,同时建议高风险数据类别采用 fail-closed 策略。

title: Gaussian Mixture Attention: Linear-Time Sequence Mixing via Probabilistic Latent Routing
summary: The dense token-to-token interaction pattern of standard dot-product attention remains a central bottleneck in scaling Transformer architectures to long contexts.
